name: The Fool
title: Le Mat
imagery: Le Mat strides to the right in a yellow jester’s cap tipped with a red bobble, a bundle slung on a stick over one shoulder and a long yellow staff in his other hand. A small pale animal leaps up behind him and tugs at his blue trousers, which have torn open at the thigh, yet he keeps walking over the tufted green ground without looking back. The card bears no number: he is the energy that moves through the whole Tarot, untamed, carrying his little bundle of experience and pushed onward by instinct.
meaning: Le Mat is pure, unnumbered energy, the traveller who belongs to no single station and therefore can pass through all of them. In the Marseille tradition he is less a naive beginner than a free spirit who has stopped asking permission, walking out of an old world toward one he cannot yet name. The animal snapping at his heels is the past, the body or the voice of instinct: it rips his clothes but cannot stop him, and in a way it drives him forward. This card blesses departures, liberation, journeys and wild inspiration, and asks you to put your enormous energy behind a direction rather than scattering it. Travel light, trust your staff, and let yourself be gloriously unclassifiable for a while.
numerology: Le Mat carries no number at all, which in the Marseille deck means he is either the zero before everything or the infinite beyond the last card. He is unlimited energy that can join any number and set it moving.
affirmation: I walk my own road, and my freedom carries me forward.

ctx.past: Somewhere behind this situation is a departure: a time you walked away from what was expected and followed your own unruly instinct. That bold, perhaps chaotic exit still shapes things now, and the energy you set loose back then is still travelling with you.
ctx.present: You are on the move, bundle on your shoulder, with something nipping at your heels. The heart of the matter is momentum: a great surge of energy wants to carry you out of the familiar. What matters now is not where you came from but which way you choose to point your steps.
ctx.future: A liberation is coming, a road opening, a journey or a sudden chance to step outside the old frame. Expect movement and a feeling of lightness, maybe a little disorder too. You will find that you are freer than you thought, and that the world makes room for a traveller.
ctx.challenge: Here Le Mat’s energy runs wild: restlessness, flight from responsibility, or so many directions at once that nothing lands. The animal tearing at your trousers may be a truth you keep outrunning. Freedom without a destination can turn into wandering, so ask what you are walking toward, not only away from.
ctx.advice: Pack your bundle and go. Leave the situation, the habit or the role that no longer fits, and trust the staff in your hand to steady you. You do not need permission or a finished plan; you need to commit your energy to one direction and keep walking.
ctx.self: You feel like an outsider right now, a little eccentric, impossible to pin down, and secretly glad of it. You have more vitality than you know what to do with. Honour your originality, and give your wildness a road to travel rather than a cage to rattle.
ctx.others: Others may see you as free, unconventional or hard to keep hold of, someone always halfway out of the door. Or a free spirit around you is stirring things up, a traveller or rebel who will not stay in their assigned place. Their unrest may be showing you where your own life has gone still.
ctx.hopes: You hope to break loose, to walk out from under every expectation and simply be yourself. You may also fear chaos, of becoming the madman nobody takes seriously or losing your footing entirely. Both point to the same longing: a freedom that is truly yours and still leads somewhere.
ctx.love: In love, Le Mat favours a relationship that leaves both people free, full of adventure, travel and spontaneity. He can also signal a restless partner, or your own need for breathing room. If you are bonded, bring movement in together; if you are single, a meeting may happen far from your usual path.
ctx.work: At work, this is the urge to leave a post, go freelance, travel for work or follow an unconventional vocation. Great energy is available, but it needs a direction and a practical bundle of skills. Original ideas will come easily; give them a structure before you hit the road.
ctx.spirit: Spirit speaks through Le Mat as the soul on pilgrimage, owing allegiance to nothing but the journey itself. Your guides are inviting you to trust the impulse that moves you, the sacred madness that refuses a too-small life. You are walking through all the cards, and you are held on every step.
ctx.release: Let go of the need to look sensible, settled or easy to explain. Release the old garment that is already torn, the identity you have outgrown. And let go of the animal snapping at your heels, the guilt or fear that follows you, by acknowledging it and walking on.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be a habit of escape: moving on just before things get deep, calling it freedom when it is avoidance. Or its opposite, a huge suppressed wildness you never let out. Notice what keeps tugging at you from behind, because it may be asking to be faced rather than fled.
ctx.foundation: At the root lies an irrepressible life force, an energy that will not sit still in the role it was given. Something in you or in the situation has always been heading out of the door. Everything else grows from that need to be free and to keep moving.
ctx.gift: Your gift is boundless energy and the courage to be unclassifiable. You can cross borders, social, inner or geographic, that stop others in their tracks. Hidden help travels with you as instinct, that small animal at your side that, for all its snapping, keeps you moving.

name: I · The Magician
title: Le Bateleur
imagery: Le Bateleur, a curly-haired young street performer in a huge hat shaped like a figure eight, stands behind a table laid with cups, dice, small balls, knives and a yellow bag. He holds a little wand up in one hand and a small round object in the other, his gaze lowered toward his tools. The table shows only three of its legs and a green shoot grows at his feet: the beginning is real but not yet complete, and everything he needs lies within reach.
meaning: Le Bateleur is the first step, the young conjurer at his market stall with all the instruments of life spread before him. In the Marseille tradition he is talent at its very beginning: skilful, eager, a little unsure, still learning which tool does what. The objects on the table are your possibilities, and his wand is the will that chooses one and puts it to work. This card says you have more resources than you think, and that now is the moment to begin, practise and play. Mastery will come with use; for now, pick something up and start.
numerology: One is the seed: total potential gathered in a single point, ready to unfold. In the Marseille numbering it is the beginning of everything, full of promise but still without experience.
affirmation: I already hold the tools I need, and I begin today.

ctx.past: This situation started with a first move, a time you set up your table and tried something new with whatever skills you had. That hopeful beginning, a little clumsy and full of promise, is the root of what you are living now, and its spark is still useful.
ctx.present: You stand at your table with the tools laid out and the wand in your hand. The heart of the matter is choosing where to begin. Every possibility is in front of you; what is asked now is that you pick one and turn potential into action.
ctx.future: A new beginning is coming, a project, role or opportunity that lets you show what you can do. Expect the excitement of a first attempt and the chance to sharpen a skill. Start small and stay curious, and your talent will grow quickly once it is in use.
ctx.challenge: The obstacle is scattered talent: too many tools, too many ideas, and no clear choice. The street conjurer can also slip into trickery, all show and little substance. Notice where you are juggling to impress rather than working to build, and choose one thing to master.
ctx.advice: Begin. Take stock of what is on your table, your skills, contacts, ideas and means, and use them rather than waiting for better ones. Practise openly, experiment, and allow yourself to be a beginner. Confidence follows action, not the other way around.
ctx.self: You see yourself as a newcomer with something to prove, clever and capable but not yet sure of your place. That fresh confidence is valuable. Trust your hands and your wit, and give yourself permission to learn in public.
ctx.others: Others see you as resourceful, quick and full of ideas, perhaps a bit of a performer. Or someone new arrives in your circle, a young or inventive person with skills to offer. Their enterprise can wake up your own, though it is worth checking that their talk matches their work.
ctx.hopes: You hope to prove yourself and to see your talents finally put to use. You may fear being found out as an amateur, or that you lack the right tools. Look again at the table: almost everything you need is already there.
ctx.love: In love, Le Bateleur brings a new beginning, a playful first approach, charm and quick conversation. A relationship may be starting, full of promise but still finding its form. In an established bond, try something new together and bring back a sense of play and initiative.
ctx.work: At work, this is the card of starting a business, taking a new post or launching a skill-based project. Use your dexterity and resourcefulness, and present your work with confidence. Organise the tools on your table before you multiply them, and let experience build steadily.
ctx.spirit: Spirit reminds you that you are a channel, that the wand raised in your hand draws energy from above and brings it down to earth through your work. Every craft can become a spiritual practice. Your guides ask you to take the first step, however small.
ctx.release: Release the belief that you need more tools, more training or more time before you can start. Let go of the impostor voice and of tricks that only dazzle. What you already have is enough to begin, and that is all this card asks.
ctx.shadow: Beneath the surface may be a fear of committing to one path, keeping every option on the table so that none can fail. There may also be some cleverness used to avoid real effort. Ask yourself which of your tools you have never truly picked up.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this matter lies a beginning and a set of resources, skill, will and possibility, waiting to be organised. The whole situation grows from how you choose to use what is on your table.
ctx.gift: Your gift is adaptability: the talent to make something from whatever is at hand. You learn quickly and can combine ideas in surprising ways. Hidden help comes through your own dexterity and through the opportunities you create by simply starting.

name: II · The Popess
title: La Papesse
imagery: La Papesse sits enthroned before a draped curtain, wearing a golden papal tiara, a white veil and a red cloak over a blue gown crossed with yellow bands. On her lap lies an open book with closely written pages, and she gazes off to one side rather than down into it. She is the woman who incubates knowledge in silence and solitude: the curtain hides a mystery not yet revealed, and the book shows wisdom that is studied, kept and slowly understood.
meaning: La Papesse is a figure of great spiritual authority in the Marseille tradition, the female pope who guards sacred knowledge and keeps it alive through patient study. She is the energy of gestation: something is being prepared inside you, slowly, in the warmth of withdrawal, and it is not yet time to show it. Her open book asks you to learn, reflect and read the signs, while her averted gaze reminds you that true understanding is also intuitive. This card favours reserve, purity of intention and faith in a process you cannot rush. Keep your counsel, nourish what is growing in secret, and trust that it will be born when it is ready.
numerology: Two is accumulation and gestation: energy gathered and held, not yet acted on. Like the egg or the seed in the dark soil, it waits and prepares in silence.
affirmation: I trust what grows in me in silence.

ctx.past: Behind this situation lies a long period of waiting, study or withdrawal, perhaps a time you kept something to yourself until it was ready. The knowledge or feelings you gathered quietly back then are the base you are standing on now, even if no one saw you gather them.
ctx.present: Something is being incubated. The heart of the matter is still inside, an idea, a feeling, a decision or a plan that needs more time and quiet before it can take form. Stay receptive, observe, and resist the pressure to act or explain before you are ready.
ctx.future: A period of reflection and inner work is coming, the chance to learn, study or deepen a spiritual practice. Answers will arrive slowly, through reading, dreams or quiet insight rather than sudden events. What is being gestated now will have its birth later.
ctx.challenge: The shadow of La Papesse is excessive reserve: coldness, rigidity or a closed door that keeps life out. Waiting can harden into paralysis, and purity into judgement. Ask whether your silence protects something precious or simply keeps you from risk and contact.
ctx.advice: Withdraw a little and listen. Study the matter in depth, write things down, consult your inner book before anyone else’s opinion. Keep your plans private for now, and give the seed time in the dark. Patience is the strategy.
ctx.self: You are in a reflective, inward mood, more observer than actor. You may feel wiser than you look and reluctant to share it. Honour this quiet, knowing part of yourself, but make sure your solitude stays fertile rather than isolating.
ctx.others: Others may see you as reserved, mysterious or hard to read, perhaps a little severe. Or a discreet, learned woman or mentor is present in your circle, someone whose quiet guidance carries weight. Her advice may come in few words, so listen carefully.
ctx.hopes: You hope to understand deeply, to find the knowledge or certainty that will settle your heart. You may fear that you will wait forever, or that what you carry inside will never be seen. Gestation is not stagnation; it is a promise kept in secret.
ctx.love: In love, La Papesse speaks of slow, careful feeling, an attraction held back, a bond that needs time and trust. She can also point to a period of being alone by choice. If you are with someone, protect intimacy and discretion; if you are waiting, let love ripen before you name it.
ctx.work: At work, this is the time for study, research, training, writing and preparation rather than launch. Projects are in development; gather information and refine your knowledge. Discretion serves you, and expertise patiently accumulated will become your authority.
ctx.spirit: Spirit speaks through La Papesse as the inner sanctuary, the holy book you carry within. Your guides invite you to meditation, sacred reading and faithful patience. The divine message is that you are a vessel, and something sacred is forming in you now.
ctx.release: Let go of the urge to rush or prove. Release the need for outside approval of what you know and feel. And if you have been hiding behind the curtain too long, let go of the fear that keeps you from stepping out when the time is ripe.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be a coldness or emotional distance you mistake for wisdom, or a secret you keep even from yourself. There may be repressed desire behind the veil. Ask what you are refusing to feel while you keep reading the book.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this matter lies something hidden or not yet born: knowledge, feeling or potential that has been quietly accumulating. The whole situation rests on what is gestating out of sight and on the patience it requires.
ctx.gift: Your gift is depth: patience, discretion and an intuitive knowledge that does not need to shout. You can hold a secret, carry a project to term and read what others miss. Hidden help comes through study, silence and the wisdom of women who came before you.

name: III · The Empress
title: L'Impératrice
imagery: L’Impératrice sits facing us on a winged throne, crowned in gold and red, holding a sceptre topped by an orb and cross in the crook of one arm. At her other side she rests a shield bearing a golden eagle, and her red robe flows over a blue bodice and gown. The wings and eagle show creative energy rising, while her direct gaze and confident posture speak of a sovereign who brings ideas into flower and rules through intelligence and charm.
meaning: L’Impératrice is creative energy bursting out after the long gestation of La Papesse. In the Marseille tradition she is the explosion of spring: abundance, fertility, seduction and ideas growing faster than they can be pruned. She rules through intelligence and natural authority rather than force, and the eagle at her side shows that her creativity is meant to rise. This card invites you to express yourself, create, flirt with life and let things grow. Not everything that blossoms now will last, and that is fine; her gift is the joyful outpouring that makes harvest possible.
numerology: Three is the first burst of creation, the sprout breaking through the soil after the gathering of two. It is youthful, abundant and a little unpredictable, energy that explodes outward without yet knowing its final form.
affirmation: I let my creativity bloom freely and abundantly.

ctx.past: This situation grew from a time of creative abundance, a flowering, a romance, a fertile idea or a season of expression. That outpouring planted many seeds, and some of them are still growing now. Remember how vibrant you felt; that energy is part of your foundation.
ctx.present: Creativity and growth are at the heart of things. Something wants to flower, a project, a relationship, a body or a talent, and the energy is strong and generous. Let yourself express and enjoy it fully, rather than holding it back for fear of imperfection.
ctx.future: A season of blossoming is approaching: abundance, new ideas, perhaps pregnancy of body or mind, and a surge of personal magnetism. Things will grow quickly. Welcome the fertility, then choose which shoots you want to nurture into lasting form.
ctx.challenge: The Empress’s excess is growth without direction, spending, starting and seducing without ever following through. Her charm can turn into vanity or a need to dominate the room. Ask whether your abundance is nourishing anything, or simply spilling everywhere.
ctx.advice: Create, express and show yourself. Write, plant, design, speak up and let your beauty and intelligence be seen. Allow yourself to enjoy the senses and the pleasure of making. Afterwards, prune lovingly, but for now let things grow.
ctx.self: You feel vibrant, fertile with ideas and confident in your own appeal. You know how to charm and to inspire. Trust this creative self-assurance, and remember that you rule your domain best when you bring others into flower too.
ctx.others: Others see you as warm, creative and magnetic, perhaps a natural leader through charm. Or an influential, generous woman in your life is shaping events, someone who encourages growth and expression. Her support can open doors and wake your talents.
ctx.hopes: You hope for abundance, creative success, beauty and the joy of being admired. You may fear that the bloom will fade, or that you will be judged as frivolous. Your creativity is serious business; let it flourish without apology.
ctx.love: In love, L’Impératrice brings seduction, sensuality and fertile connection, a time of mutual attraction and affection that grows. She may indicate a new romance or a deepening bond, even the wish for a family. Express your feelings openly and enjoy being desired.
ctx.work: At work, this is a fertile time for creative fields, communication, launches and fresh ideas. Your charisma and intelligence give you natural authority. Produce generously, network with warmth, and then give the most promising projects structure so they bear fruit.
ctx.spirit: Spirit speaks through the Empress as the creative force of nature itself, the divine feminine that brings form from the formless. Your guides are inviting you to see your own creativity as sacred. Every flowering is a prayer answered.
ctx.release: Let go of self-criticism and the urge to perfect everything before it is shown. Release scarcity thinking and the fear of being too much. And release a few of the shoots you cannot tend, so the strongest can thrive.
ctx.shadow: Hidden beneath this card may be a need to be admired that drives more than you realise, or creativity scattered to avoid finishing anything. There may also be unexpressed talent kept small for fear of envy. Notice what you are not allowing to grow.
ctx.foundation: At the root of the matter lies a strong creative force, desire, fertility and the wish to make something beautiful. The situation was born from an outpouring of energy, and everything rests on how that energy is expressed and shaped.
ctx.gift: Your gift is creative abundance and natural charisma. You can bring ideas to life, inspire others and make things grow where there was nothing. Hidden help comes through beauty, through generous women and through the joy of expressing yourself.

name: IV · The Emperor
title: L'Empereur
imagery: L’Empereur is shown in profile, bearded and crowned, leaning against a throne with his legs crossed, a heavy gold chain around his neck. He holds out a sceptre crowned by an orb and cross in one hand and hooks the other into his golden belt, while a shield with a golden eagle rests on the ground at his feet among tufts of green. His crossed legs and settled pose show a power that is firmly established on the earth, and the eagle lowered beside him shows ambition now resting in secure possession.
meaning: L’Empereur is the master of the material world, the one who builds, protects and keeps things in order. Where the Empress pours out creativity, he gives it a frame: rules, foundations, budgets and walls that make life safe and dependable. In the Marseille tradition he is responsible power, a father figure or authority who takes care of his domain without needing to prove anything. This card asks you to take charge, stabilise what you have and act with steady confidence. Order is not the enemy of life here; it is the ground on which life can stand.
numerology: Four is stability: the square, the table on four legs, the solid house. It is the number of material security and of power that has found its footing on the earth.
affirmation: I build a solid ground beneath my life and stand on it with confidence.

ctx.past: This situation rests on structures built earlier: a home, a job, a rule, or a father figure whose authority shaped you. That foundation gave stability, and perhaps some rigidity too. Recognise what was solidly built back then, since you are still standing on it.
ctx.present: The heart of the matter is order and responsibility. You are called to take charge, set boundaries and make practical decisions that secure your domain. Stability is available if you claim your authority calmly and act like the ruler of your own life.
ctx.future: Stability is coming: a firmer position, a secure income, a home or structure that finally holds. You may be offered more responsibility or authority. Accept it with a steady hand, and the ground you build will support you for a long time.
ctx.challenge: The Emperor’s excess is control: rigidity, stubbornness, coldness, or a need to dominate rather than protect. Order can harden into a cage. Ask where you are clinging to power or routine out of fear, and where a little flexibility would actually make you stronger.
ctx.advice: Take command. Make a plan, set a budget, create a routine, lay down a clear boundary. Act from calm authority rather than anxiety, and protect what matters to you. Build slowly and solidly, one square stone at a time.
ctx.self: You see yourself as the responsible one, the person others lean on. You are capable of great steadiness and practical leadership. Honour that strength, while making sure your armour of competence does not keep out tenderness and help.
ctx.others: Others perceive you as solid, reliable and authoritative, perhaps a bit inflexible. Or an authority figure, a boss, father, official or protector, plays a key role around you. His support can be valuable; deal with him directly and practically.
ctx.hopes: You long for security, control and a life that finally feels stable and protected. You may fear losing your position, or being dominated by someone else’s authority. Real power begins with knowing what you can truly govern, starting with yourself.
ctx.love: In love, L’Empereur brings commitment, loyalty and a protective partner, a relationship that wants a solid base such as a shared home or a clear agreement. He can also signal too much control. Offer stability with warmth, and let love be a kingdom you rule together.
ctx.work: At work, this card favours leadership, management, property, administration and building lasting enterprises. Establish clear procedures, take ownership and assert your competence. Concrete results come from steady effort and sound structures rather than inspiration alone.
ctx.spirit: Spirit speaks through L’Empereur as the sacredness of the material world: caring for your body, home and responsibilities is also a spiritual act. Your guides ask you to ground your ideals in practice. Heaven is honoured when earth is well kept.
ctx.release: Let go of the need to control every detail, and of the belief that safety depends on never changing. Release outdated rules inherited from authority figures. Keep the structures that serve you, and loosen the ones that only confine.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be a fear of chaos that drives you to control, or an unacknowledged longing for a protector of your own. There may be a conflict with your father or with authority still shaping your choices. Look at who holds the sceptre in your inner world.
ctx.foundation: At the root lies the need for security and structure, material stability and a clear order you can rely on. The situation grows from questions of power, responsibility and the ground beneath your feet, and from who, in the end, holds the sceptre over your choices.
ctx.gift: Your gift is reliability: the ability to make things solid, to organise and to protect. People feel safe in your presence. Hidden help comes through institutions, mentors or simply through the strength of a well-built plan.

name: V · The Pope
title: Le Pape
imagery: Le Pape sits between two blue pillars, a gold triple tiara on his bearded head and a triple cross staff in his gloved hand, the glove marked with a small cross. His other hand is raised to his chest, and before him kneel two tonsured disciples seen from behind, one looking up to him. He is the bridge between heaven and earth and the teacher who speaks to those who come to listen; the pillars frame the sacred space, and the disciples show that his wisdom exists in order to be passed on.
meaning: Le Pape is the great communicator of the Marseille deck, the master who builds a bridge between the spiritual and the human and passes knowledge from one generation to the next. Where La Papesse studies in silence, he teaches aloud, blesses and mediates. He represents ideals, ethics and the search for meaning, and also the people who guide us: teachers, mentors, counsellors and wise elders. This card invites you to seek or share guidance, to commit to an ideal and to speak in a way that unites rather than divides. Sometimes you are the disciple and sometimes the teacher; the card asks which role is yours today.
numerology: Five opens a new horizon beyond the stability of four: an ideal, a bridge to something higher. It is the number of the mediator, who stands with one foot in the known and one reaching toward what is greater.
affirmation: I listen for wisdom, and I share what I know with care.

ctx.past: A teacher, mentor, tradition or set of values shaped the background of this situation. Someone once taught you, blessed you or showed you a way of seeing, and that lesson still guides your choices. Consider which of those teachings you still believe and which you have outgrown.
ctx.present: Communication and meaning are at the heart of this matter. You are seeking guidance, or being called to give it. A conversation, a mentor or a clear ideal can connect what has been divided, so speak honestly and listen with respect.
ctx.future: Guidance is on its way: a teacher, a counsellor, a course of study or a meaningful conversation that opens a bridge. You may also find yourself in the role of the one who advises. Expect a clearer sense of purpose and a message worth hearing.
ctx.challenge: Here Le Pape’s energy turns rigid: dogma, moralising, blind obedience, or advice given from a pedestal. Rules can replace real understanding. Ask where you are following a doctrine without questioning it, or where you are preaching instead of truly communicating.
ctx.advice: Seek wise counsel or offer it. Talk to someone you respect, find a mentor, take a class, or teach what you know. Align your actions with your highest values. Speak clearly and kindly, and remember that a good teacher also listens.
ctx.self: You see yourself as someone who understands and wants to share, perhaps a natural guide or confidant. You may also feel like a student in search of a master. Honour both sides: the wisdom you have and the humility to keep learning.
ctx.others: Others may see you as wise, trustworthy or a little authoritative, someone to turn to for advice. Or a teacher, priest, therapist or elder has influence in your life now. Their words may carry a blessing if you approach them with an open heart.
ctx.hopes: You hope for meaning, a clear path, and someone or something worth believing in. You may fear being misled, or being judged by the standards of others. The true bridge begins with your own sincere listening.
ctx.love: In love, Le Pape speaks of commitment, shared values and honest communication, possibly marriage or a formal promise. He favours a partner you can talk to deeply. If there is tension, a respectful conversation, or a wise third party, can help you find common ground.
ctx.work: At work, this card favours teaching, counselling, mediation, communication and fields grounded in ethics. Mentorship matters now, whether you give it or receive it. Work within respected structures, share what you know generously, and let your integrity become your reputation.
ctx.spirit: Spirit speaks through Le Pape as a bridge between the earthly and the divine. Your guides may be reaching you through a teacher, a sacred text or a tradition. The message is that you are never alone on the path: wisdom is being handed down to you.
ctx.release: Let go of borrowed beliefs that no longer ring true, and of the need for an authority to approve your path. Release the urge to convert others. Keep the essence of what you were taught, and let the outer forms change if they must.
ctx.shadow: Hidden beneath this card may be a fear of thinking for yourself, or a secret wish to be the one with all the answers. There may be resentment toward a past teacher or institution. Notice where you seek a guru rather than your own understanding.
ctx.foundation: At the root lies a question of values, beliefs or communication: what you were taught, what you hold sacred, and how you pass it on. The situation grows from your relationship with teaching and authority.
ctx.gift: Your gift is the ability to connect, to explain, reconcile and bring people toward something higher. You can be a bridge for others. Hidden help comes through wise mentors, spiritual communities and the knowledge of those who walked before you.

name: VI · The Lover
title: L'Amoureux
imagery: L’Amoureux shows a young man in a striped tunic standing between two women: the one on the left, crowned with a golden wreath, lays a hand on his shoulder, while the one on the right, with a green-gold band in her hair, touches him at the chest. Above them, a winged Cupid in a white sun with many coloured rays aims his arrow downward. The young man is held between two pulls, perhaps old loyalties and new desire, and the arrow from above shows that the true choice comes from the heart and from a power greater than reasoning.
meaning: L’Amoureux is not simply a love card in the Marseille tradition; it is the card of emotional life and of the choices that shape it. The young man is caught among relationships, family and partner, duty and desire, the familiar and the new, and he must find what truly moves him. Cupid’s sunlit arrow suggests that the answer will come from the heart rather than from calculation, and that genuine union begins with doing what you love. This card speaks of attraction, friendship, community and the pleasure of being with others. It asks you to choose with sincerity, to stop pleasing everyone and to follow what makes your heart come alive.
numerology: Six is the number of pleasure and beauty in the Marseille tradition, the joy of discovering what you love. It is also the first great choice, the moment of following one’s heart.
affirmation: I choose with my heart, and I choose what I truly love.

ctx.past: The background of this situation holds an important choice of the heart or a web of relationships: family ties, a love triangle, friendships or loyalties that pulled you in different directions. How you chose back then, or failed to choose, continues to shape your feelings now.
ctx.present: You are standing between two paths or two people, or between what is expected of you and what you desire. The heart of the matter is emotional honesty. Listen to what truly attracts you, and let Cupid’s arrow point the way rather than obligation alone.
ctx.future: A choice or a meeting is ahead, a new relationship, a social opening or a moment when you must decide where your heart really belongs. Expect emotion, attraction and some complexity. Choose what brings you alive, and pleasure will follow.
ctx.challenge: The Lover’s shadow is indecision and emotional confusion: being torn between options, people-pleasing, or letting others choose for you. Desire can also scatter attention across too many directions. Ask what you are avoiding by keeping every door open.
ctx.advice: Decide with your heart. Clarify what you love, what you want and what you are doing only out of habit or guilt. Have honest conversations with the people involved. Choose sincerely, and then commit to your choice fully.
ctx.self: You feel drawn in several directions, perhaps loved and needed by many, and unsure where your own desire lies. You are sociable and open-hearted. Take time to listen inwardly, and give yourself permission to want what you want.
ctx.others: Others may see you as charming, sociable or hard to pin down. The people around you are pulling at you with their own wishes, perhaps family on one side and a partner or friends on the other. Their influence is real, yet the choice remains yours.
ctx.hopes: You hope for love, harmony and a choice that feels unmistakably right. You may fear choosing wrongly, hurting someone, or being left out. Clarity grows when you stop asking what others want and start asking what you love.
ctx.love: In love, L’Amoureux is a strong card of attraction and emotional connection, but also of choice: between two people, or between a relationship and other loyalties. It can signal a new romance or a bond at a crossroads. Be honest with yourself and others about what you feel.
ctx.work: At work, this card points to a decision between options, offers or partnerships, and favours working with others in a pleasant team. Choose the path you are passionate about rather than the one that only looks safe. Good relationships at work bring real benefit now.
ctx.spirit: Spirit speaks through the Lover as the call to love itself. Cupid shoots from the sun: your guides are reminding you that the heart’s true desire is often a divine message. Follow what you love, and you follow your soul’s path.
ctx.release: Let go of the need to please everyone and of obligations you have outgrown. Release loyalties that keep you from your own path, and the fear of disappointing others. A choice made freely is lighter than one made from guilt.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be emotional dependence on others’ approval, or an unconscious family pattern guiding your choices. There may be a desire you have not admitted even to yourself. Notice which hand on your shoulder you have not yet named.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this matter lie emotional bonds and an important choice, family, love, friendship and the tension between them. The situation grows from what you feel and from the question of what, or whom, you truly love.
ctx.gift: Your gift is the capacity to love and to connect. You draw people together and know how to find pleasure and beauty in relationships. Hidden help comes through friends, community and an inner voice that knows what you really want.

name: VII · The Chariot
title: Le Chariot
imagery: A crowned young prince stands in a square chariot under a canopy held up by four posts, two red and two blue, holding a golden sceptre in one hand. He wears armour with crescent-faced masks on his shoulders, and the front of the chariot bears a shield marked V T. Two blue horses pull before him, their heads turned in different directions, with no reins in sight, and a large wheel shows beside them over a ground of green tufts. He steers by will alone: the masks show that he holds day and night, joy and sorrow together, and the horses that he moves forward even when his forces pull apart.
meaning: Le Chariot is action in the world, the moment when inner energy finally rolls out and conquers space. In the Marseille tradition he is the triumphant traveller who has integrated his opposites and now moves with confidence, guided by inner mastery rather than outer control. The absence of reins tells you that force is not needed: clarity of purpose keeps the horses moving together. This card brings success, progress, journeys and recognition, and asks you to take your place in the world with courage. Stand tall in your chariot and go where your will is carrying you.
numerology: Seven is the most active number of the first series: energy fully deployed in the world. It is movement, conquest and accomplishment, power directed outward to change things.
affirmation: I move forward with confidence, and my will carries me to my goal.

ctx.past: Behind this situation is a time of strong forward movement, a victory, a move, a journey or a period when you took charge and advanced. That momentum laid the groundwork for where you stand now, and the confidence you gained then is still yours.
ctx.present: You are in motion. The heart of the matter is action: taking your place, moving forward and steering your life toward a clear goal. You have the power to direct opposing forces, so commit fully and let your purpose hold the horses together.
ctx.future: Progress is coming: success, advancement, travel or the triumphant completion of an effort. Things will move quickly. Stay centred in your chariot, keep your sceptre of intention raised, and you will cover a great deal of ground.
ctx.challenge: The Chariot’s excess is impatience, aggression or a drive to win at any cost. You may be going so fast that you ignore the tug of the horses pulling apart, or the people left behind. Ask whether you are mastering your forces or simply being carried away by them.
ctx.advice: Act. Decide on your direction and move toward it with determination and grace. Take the trip, make the move, apply for the post, claim the victory. Hold your opposites together with a clear goal rather than force, and trust your own guidance.
ctx.self: You feel capable, ambitious and ready to conquer, and you carry yourself like someone who knows where they are going. Honour that confidence and the courage behind it. Remember, though, that real mastery includes knowing when to stop and rest the horses.
ctx.others: Others see you as dynamic, successful and in control, perhaps someone always on the move. Or an energetic, ambitious person around you is driving events forward. Their momentum can carry you along if your directions align.
ctx.hopes: You hope for success, recognition and the feeling of moving freely through the world. You may fear losing control, or that your inner conflicts will stall your progress. Your will is stronger than the division you fear.
ctx.love: In love, Le Chariot brings movement: a relationship that progresses, travel together, or a confident advance toward someone you desire. It can also suggest a partner devoted to their ambitions. Keep the relationship moving forward, and share the journey rather than leading alone.
ctx.work: At work, this is a card of success, promotion, expansion and travel. Your projects are ready to go out into the world. Take initiative, show your strength and lead with clear intention. Victory favours decisive, well-directed effort.
ctx.spirit: Spirit speaks through Le Chariot as the soul acting in the world. Your guides remind you that you are a vehicle for something greater, and that your achievements can serve a higher purpose. Move forward in the knowledge that you are guided.
ctx.release: Let go of hesitation and of waiting for perfect conditions. Release the belief that you must control everything by force. And let go of inner conflicts that keep your horses pulling apart; choose your direction and allow the rest to follow.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be a fear of stillness, a need to keep moving or achieving so you never have to feel what lies beneath. Ambition may mask insecurity. Notice what you are racing away from as well as what you are racing toward.
ctx.foundation: At the root of the matter lies a strong will to act and progress, the drive to take your place in the world. The situation rests on movement, ambition and the question of where you are headed.
ctx.gift: Your gift is drive, the power to turn intention into concrete movement and to carry others with you. You can unite opposing forces and achieve your goals. Hidden help comes through travel, opportunities and your own unshakeable will.

name: XI · Strength
title: La Force
imagery: La Force shows a woman in a wide blue-and-gold hat curved like a figure eight, wearing a blue gown with yellow sleeves and a red cloak, her gaze lowered as she leans toward a golden lion. With calm, bare hands she holds the lion’s jaws as it lifts its shaggy head toward her, its mane flowing down beside her skirt. Her hat echoes that of Le Bateleur, linking this card to a fresh beginning, and the lion shows the raw animal and creative force she neither kills nor fears but works with in close partnership.
meaning: La Force, numbered XI in the Marseille deck, opens the second half of the Major Arcana with a new kind of power: the meeting of conscious intelligence with the deep animal forces of instinct, desire and creativity. The woman does not fight the lion; she relates to it, and the lion looks up to her as a partner. This card speaks of courage, vitality and the ability to channel powerful energy without repressing it. It asks you to make peace with your own wild nature, your anger, sexuality, appetite or creative fire, and to let it serve you. True strength here is gentle, steady and deeply alive.
numerology: Eleven begins the second series of the Majors. Like the One of Le Bateleur, it is a beginning, but now the energy rises from the depths: instinct, the body and the unconscious entering into dialogue with the mind.
affirmation: I hold my wild strength with a gentle hand, and it serves my life.

ctx.past: This situation grew from a time you met a powerful force, an emotion, a desire, a challenge or an instinct, and learned to live with it rather than run from it. The courage and self-knowledge you gained then are still at work beneath the surface of today.
ctx.present: The heart of the matter is your relationship with your own vital energy. Something strong and instinctive is asking to be acknowledged and directed: passion, anger, creative drive or desire. Meet it with calm attention, and it will become a powerful ally.
ctx.future: A new surge of strength and vitality is coming. You will find the courage to face what once frightened you, and the energy to begin something from deep inside yourself. Expect a renewed connection to your body, your creativity and your confidence.
ctx.challenge: Strength’s challenge is the struggle between control and instinct. You may be suppressing your wildness, or letting it run the show. Gentleness can slip into passivity, and power into force. Ask how to work with your lion, not against it, and not under it.
ctx.advice: Lean toward what you fear, gently. Acknowledge your instincts, emotions and desires without judgement, and give them a healthy outlet in creative work, movement, honest speech or passion. Lead with patience and steady presence rather than force.
ctx.self: You feel strong, perhaps stronger than you realise, with a deep reserve of vitality and courage. You are learning to trust your instincts. Honour both the calm woman and the roaring lion within you; together they make you whole.
ctx.others: Others see you as confident, grounded and quietly powerful, someone who can handle intensity. Or a person around you shows remarkable strength or tames a difficult situation with grace. Their example may encourage you to trust your own power.
ctx.hopes: You hope to feel strong, vital and at peace with yourself, master of your own forces. You may fear your own intensity, or fear being overwhelmed by emotions or desires. Your lion is not your enemy; it is your hidden power.
ctx.love: In love, La Force speaks of passion handled with tenderness, a relationship where desire and kindness coexist. It can signal a strong attraction, or the courage to show your true self. Let intimacy be both gentle and alive, and meet difficult feelings with patience.
ctx.work: At work, this card favours courageous, creative projects and steady leadership. You have the energy to begin something ambitious and the patience to see it through. Handle difficult people or situations with calm authority rather than confrontation.
ctx.spirit: Spirit speaks through La Force as the sacredness of the body and its instincts. Your guides invite you to unite heaven and earth within yourself, to find the divine in your vitality and desire. The animal soul is part of the holy whole.
ctx.release: Let go of the war with your own nature, the shame about desire, anger or appetite. Release the belief that strength means hardness. Let go too of the fear of your own power, and allow it to serve you.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be repressed anger, sexuality or creative energy that you have learned to keep tightly controlled. Or an instinct running unchecked while you pretend all is calm. Notice what roars in you when no one is listening.
ctx.foundation: At the root of the matter lies a deep life force: instinct, desire and creative energy rising from within. The situation grows from your relationship with this power and how you choose to direct it.
ctx.gift: Your gift is grounded courage, the power to face intensity without losing your gentleness. You can bring calm to wild situations and creativity out of raw energy. Hidden help comes from your body, your instincts and a vitality that does not run out.

name: IX · The Hermit
title: L'Hermite
imagery: L’Hermite, numbered VIIII, is an old bearded man in a blue hooded cloak lined with red, leaning on a pale staff as he walks toward the left. He lifts a small red lantern half hidden behind a fold of his cloak, his tired, attentive eyes looking beyond it. His backward-facing walk and veiled lantern show that he is leaving a stage of life behind, and that he offers his light discreetly, to those who come looking for it.
meaning: L’Hermite is the wise elder who has walked a long road and now moves forward by stepping back. In the Marseille tradition the card marks a crisis in the deep sense, a passage: one cycle is ending, the old ways are no longer enough, and the next form is not yet visible. His lantern holds the light of experience, which he shares quietly rather than imposing. This card asks you to withdraw, reflect, let go of what is finished and trust the wisdom you have earned. Solitude now is not loneliness but a sacred pause before a new beginning.
numerology: Nine is the number of crisis and passage in the Marseille tradition: the end of one cycle and the preparation for the next. It brings wisdom and maturity, along with the need to let go.
affirmation: I trust the light I carry, and I walk my path with patience.

ctx.past: Behind this situation is a time of withdrawal, solitude or soul-searching, perhaps a crisis that forced you to step away and reconsider. The wisdom you gathered in that quiet season is part of what guides you now, even if it came at a cost.
ctx.present: You are in a period of transition and reflection. The heart of the matter is inner: a phase of life is ending, and you need time alone to understand what comes next. Slow down, hold your lantern close and trust your own experience.
ctx.future: A time of retreat and maturity is coming, a chance to step back, study, travel inwardly or seek counsel. Something will end gracefully so that something new can be prepared. You will emerge wiser, with a clearer light to guide you.
ctx.challenge: The Hermit’s challenge is isolation, withdrawal that becomes loneliness, or wisdom that stays locked away. You may be clinging to an ending or hiding from the world. Ask whether your solitude is healing you or simply keeping others at a distance.
ctx.advice: Take time alone to reflect. Step back from busyness, simplify, and listen to your own experience. Seek the advice of someone older or wiser, or become that guide for someone else. Move slowly and let what is finished be finished.
ctx.self: You feel older, wiser or a little weary, someone who has seen a great deal and wants depth rather than noise. Honour your need for quiet and your hard-won knowledge. Your light is valuable, even if it is soft.
ctx.others: Others may see you as wise, reserved or withdrawn, someone who keeps to themselves. Or an elder, mentor or therapist figures in your life now, offering guidance in a quiet way. Their lantern can light your next step if you approach them.
ctx.hopes: You hope for wisdom, peace and clarity, the feeling of finally understanding. You may fear loneliness, ageing or being left behind. The Hermit walks alone, yet he is never lost, and his path leads toward renewal.
ctx.love: In love, L’Hermite may indicate a period of solitude, a need for space, or a relationship moving toward greater depth and maturity. It favours sincere, patient connection over passion. Take time to understand your heart before making decisions.
ctx.work: At work, this card favours research, expertise, mentorship and careful work done in quiet. A phase may be ending, prompting you to reconsider your path. Use your experience wisely, avoid hasty choices, and let patience guide your next step.
ctx.spirit: Spirit speaks through the Hermit as the inner light that shines in darkness. Your guides invite you to retreat, meditate and trust that wisdom comes through stillness. The lantern you carry was lit by all you have lived.
ctx.release: Let go of what has run its course: old ambitions, outgrown relationships, habits that belong to an earlier stage of life. Release the need to rush toward the next thing or to fill every silence. Trust the pause, and let the lantern show you only the next step.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be a fear of being seen, a tendency to hide your light or to withdraw from life out of disappointment. There may be grief for what is ending that you have not yet acknowledged. Notice what you are retreating from as well as toward.
ctx.foundation: At the root of the matter lies a transition, the end of a cycle and the need to step back and reflect. The situation grows from this crisis of passage and the wisdom it is asking you to claim.
ctx.gift: Your gift is wisdom drawn from experience and the patience to see clearly. You can guide others through darkness with a quiet light. Hidden help comes through solitude, older mentors and the knowledge you already carry.

name: X · The Wheel of Fortune
title: La Roue de Fortune
imagery: A spoked wheel with a red hub stands on a yellow wooden frame above a striped ground. On a small platform at the top sits a crowned, winged creature with a blue body holding a sword, while a creature in a red and blue skirt, with a long tail, tumbles head-first down the left side and a dog-headed animal in yellow, blue and red climbs up the right. The rising and falling figures show that every situation turns, and the crowned sphinx above shows the still point of wisdom that watches the cycle without being carried by it.
meaning: La Roue de Fortune marks the end of a cycle and the threshold of a new one. In the Marseille tradition it is a turning point: what has been rising begins to fall, what has been low begins to rise, and the wheel waits for a new impulse to set it moving again. Nothing is permanent here, and that is good news as much as a warning. This card asks you to accept change, recognise the patterns that keep repeating, and look for the hand that can turn the wheel in a new direction. Luck favours those who work with the cycle rather than against it.
numerology: Ten completes the first series of numbers: a full cycle has been lived, and a new one is waiting to begin. It is both an ending and a threshold, a stillness before the next impulse.
affirmation: I welcome the turning of my life and trust the new cycle beginning.

ctx.past: This situation was shaped by a turn of fortune, a stroke of luck or a sudden change of circumstances that ended one phase and opened another. You have lived a full cycle, with its ups and downs, and that experience is the ground from which you now move.
ctx.present: You are at a turning point. The heart of the matter is change, the end of a cycle and the uncertainty before the next one. Something is shifting whether you like it or not; your task is to see the pattern and choose how to meet the new turn.
ctx.future: A change of fortune is coming, a new cycle, an unexpected opportunity or a shift in circumstances. Things will start to move after a period of standstill. Stay flexible, be ready to seize the moment, and you can ride the turn upward.
ctx.challenge: The Wheel’s challenge is feeling helpless before change, or repeating the same cycle without learning from it. You may wait for luck instead of acting, or cling to what is falling away. Ask what pattern keeps coming round, and how you might break it.
ctx.advice: Accept that a cycle is ending, and look for the new impulse. Notice what repeats in your life and decide to act differently this time. Be ready when opportunity turns your way. Grasp the handle and help the wheel move.
ctx.self: You may feel subject to forces beyond your control, carried up or down by events. Yet you can also be the one who sits calmly at the top, watching the turn. Find your still centre, and you will move with change rather than be thrown by it.
ctx.others: Others may see you as lucky, unpredictable or in the middle of big changes. Or the people around you are going through their own cycles, rising and falling. Their changes may open doors for you, so stay alert to new connections.
ctx.hopes: You hope for luck, for a turn in your favour or an end to a difficult phase. You may fear that good times cannot last, or that you are stuck in a loop. Every wheel turns; nothing stays down forever.
ctx.love: In love, La Roue de Fortune signals change: a new chapter, a fated meeting, or the end of a relationship cycle that clears space for something new. Patterns from the past may be repeating. Recognise them, and choose differently if you need to.
ctx.work: At work, this card points to changing circumstances: new opportunities, the end of a project, or shifts in the market. Stay adaptable, watch for timing, and be ready to act when the wheel turns in your favour. Avoid depending on luck alone.
ctx.spirit: Spirit speaks through the Wheel as the great cycle of existence, birth and ending, rise and fall. Your guides invite you to see the bigger pattern and to find peace at the still centre of change. You are part of a larger turning.
ctx.release: Let go of the need for permanence, and of attachment to how things used to be. Release the belief that you are merely a victim of fate. Let go of the old cycle so that the new one can begin.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be a repeating pattern you have not yet recognised, a family story or habit that keeps the wheel turning in the same groove. There may also be a fear of change disguised as bad luck. Look for what keeps coming round.
ctx.foundation: At the root of the matter lies a cycle reaching completion, a pattern of rise and fall that has run its full course and is now ready for transformation. The whole situation grows from this turning point and from the new impulse it is waiting for.
ctx.gift: Your gift is adaptability and a sense of timing, the ability to see patterns and to move when the moment is right. You can find opportunity in change. Hidden help comes through fortunate coincidences and new cycles opening at the right time.

name: VIII · Justice
title: La Justice
imagery: A crowned woman sits squarely between the two golden posts of her throne, facing you head-on with a level, unblinking gaze. She wears a red gown under a wide blue mantle with a golden cord at her throat; one hand rests at her breast while the other, lowered, holds the golden balance whose two pans hang evenly on either side of her. Her frontal stillness is the point: La Justice does not turn away, does not hurry, and weighs everything against the truth she keeps close to her heart.
meaning: In the Marseille sequence Justice is VIII, the number of perfect balance, and she sits like a living law at the centre of the card. She asks you to look at your situation exactly as it is, without flattery and without self-punishment, and to give each thing its true weight. This is the card of honest accounts, fair agreements and decisions made with a clear head and a steady heart. Her hand at her breast reminds you that real justice is not cold: it is the heart’s own sense of what is right, made firm. When she appears, what you have sown is coming into measure, and you are invited to act with integrity so the scales settle in your favour.
numerology: In the Marseille numerology eight is the number of perfection on the material plane: two times four, a stable square doubled into complete equilibrium where nothing is missing and nothing is excess.
affirmation: I weigh my life honestly and choose what is right.

ctx.past: A decision, agreement or reckoning lies at the root of where you stand now. Perhaps a contract was signed, a truth was spoken, or a consequence finally arrived. That moment of weighing set the terms you are still living within, and understanding it clearly will help you see why things balanced out the way they did.
ctx.present: You are sitting in Justice’s chair right now, asked to look straight ahead and weigh what is really before you. The heart of the matter is fairness: to others, and just as much to yourself. Set down the stories and the excuses, place the facts in the pans, and let the truth show you how the balance falls.
ctx.future: A fair outcome is on its way. Expect a decision, a settlement, an answer or a clarifying conversation that sets things in proper order. What arrives will reflect what has truly been put in, so the more honestly you act now, the more gladly you will greet the verdict when it comes.
ctx.challenge: The obstacle is justice gone rigid: harsh judgement of yourself or others, perfectionism, or a need to be right at any cost. You may be weighing every word so carefully that nothing can move. The scales were meant to find balance, not to punish, so let compassion sit beside your sense of fairness.
ctx.advice: Get clear and get honest. Write down the facts, read the fine print, keep your promises and ask for what is fairly yours. Make your decision from the centre, as Justice sits between her two pillars, rather than from fear on one side or wishful thinking on the other.
ctx.self: You see yourself as the one who has to hold the balance, perhaps the sensible one, the judge, the keeper of order. Your sense of integrity is strong. Make sure you also extend that fairness inward, and admit honestly what you need as well as what you owe.
ctx.others: Others may see you as principled, measured and a little hard to fool. Alternatively, someone around you is acting as judge, mediator, official or adviser, and their verdict matters here. Meet them with straightforward facts; this is an environment where clarity and good faith are respected.
ctx.hopes: You hope for fairness, for recognition that you acted rightly, for a situation finally set straight. You may fear being judged, found wanting, or held to account. Both feelings point to the same wish: to stand in the truth and have the truth be enough.
ctx.love: In love, Justice asks for equality and honest give-and-take. Are both of you carrying a fair share of the effort, the tenderness and the responsibility? Clear agreements and frank conversation strengthen a bond now. For a new connection, look for someone whose values truly match yours.
ctx.work: At work and with money, this card favours contracts, negotiations, paperwork and careful records. Read everything, keep receipts and make sure terms are fair to all sides. A balanced, well-documented approach will serve you, and decisions made on facts rather than impulse are the ones that hold.
ctx.spirit: Spirit speaks of the deep law of balance that runs beneath all things. What you give comes back in its own measure. Your guides ask you to live in alignment with your conscience, trusting that the truth you keep at your heart is a sacred compass.
ctx.release: Let go of the urge to keep score, of old grudges and of verdicts you passed on yourself long ago. Release the belief that you must be perfect to be worthy. Put down the heavy sword of blame and keep only the scales.
ctx.shadow: Hidden beneath may be a quiet self-righteousness, or a part of you that avoids a decision because choosing means taking responsibility. There might also be a truth you already know but have not yet admitted. Justice looks straight at you; try looking straight back.
ctx.foundation: At the root lies a question of balance: something weighed unfairly, a promise kept or broken, a choice whose consequences are still unfolding. Everything else here rests on that measure, and it can be restored by honest accounting.
ctx.gift: Your gift is clear sight and a steady heart. You can see what is fair even when others are swept up in emotion, and you can make a decision and stand by it. Hidden help may come through a just ruling, a trustworthy ally or simply the truth coming out.

name: XII · The Hanged Man
title: Le Pendu
imagery: A young man hangs upside down by one foot from a crossbar laid between two yellow trees, each trunk marked with red stubs where branches have been cut. His free leg bends behind the other to make the shape of a 4, his hands are hidden behind his back, and his blue hair falls toward the green mounds below, yet his face is calm and his eyes are open. The cut branches speak of what has been pruned away, the hidden hands of a time when doing must give way to being, and his serene face of the strange peace found in surrender.
meaning: Le Pendu is the card of the sacred pause. Everything stops, and in that stopping something new can be seen, because the world looks entirely different from upside down. In the Marseille tradition he is not punished but suspended by choice, a seeker who lets go of control so that the inner life can ripen, like a fruit hanging until it is ready to fall. He invites you to stop pushing, to accept a delay or a waiting time, and to look at your situation from an unexpected angle. What feels like being stuck is often gestation. Give something up willingly, and you will find that the surrender itself carries a gift.
numerology: Twelve is a completed cycle (the twelve months, the twelve signs) and in the Marseille sequence it is also one plus two, three: a quiet, inward creativity that grows in the dark before it shows itself.
affirmation: I let go, and in the stillness I begin to see.

ctx.past: A time of waiting or suspension shaped where you stand now. Perhaps plans were put on hold, you gave something up, or you were forced to stop and look at life differently. That pause was not wasted: it turned your view upside down and planted insights that are only now coming into the light.
ctx.present: You are hanging between one chapter and the next, unable to force the outcome, and the heart of the matter is how you hold that suspension. Struggle tightens the rope; stillness loosens it. Turn the problem over, look at it from below, and notice what you could not see while you were busy rushing.
ctx.future: A pause is coming, a delay or a period of rest that asks you to stop doing and simply let things ripen. It may feel frustrating at first, but it brings a new perspective that changes everything. What looks like a standstill will turn out to be the turning point.
ctx.challenge: The obstacle is being stuck in limbo: endless waiting, martyrdom, or sacrificing yourself in ways nobody asked for. You may be using passivity to avoid a choice. The Pendu’s surrender is meant to be fruitful, so ask whether your waiting is ripening something or simply keeping you hanging.
ctx.advice: Stop pushing. Take a step back, sleep on it, meditate, or deliberately try the opposite of what you have been doing. Let go of one thing willingly so your hands are free again. The answer comes when you change the angle, not when you pull harder on the rope.
ctx.self: You may feel suspended, out of step with everyone else, seeing the world in a way others don’t. That is not a flaw. Your unusual view is a source of wisdom right now, and your calm acceptance of not knowing is quietly powerful.
ctx.others: Others may see you as stalled, dreamy or unconventional, or they may be waiting on you to make a move. Someone around you might also be in a holding pattern, making sacrifices or simply unavailable for now. Patience with each other will serve better than pressure.
ctx.hopes: You may hope for a release from waiting, or secretly long for permission to stop and rest. You might fear that nothing will ever change, or that letting go means losing. Both hopes and fears are asking you to trust the ripening.
ctx.love: In love, this card suggests a relationship in suspension, a pause, a long-distance phase or a time when one of you needs space. It asks for patience and fresh eyes. Try seeing your partner, or the situation, from their side; a small sacrifice of pride can open a door.
ctx.work: At work, projects may be on hold or awaiting approval, and forcing them will not help. Use the lull to rethink your approach, learn, or quietly prepare. Unconventional ideas could be your breakthrough; the solution may lie in doing the exact opposite of the usual plan.
ctx.spirit: Spirit invites surrender. Your guides ask you to release the need to control and let a greater wisdom carry you for a while. This is the mystic’s pause, where hanging in trust becomes a form of prayer and insight drops in like a fruit from the tree.
ctx.release: Release the need to make things happen on your schedule. Let go of struggling against what you cannot change, and of the old way of seeing that no longer fits. Untie your hands from behind your back by simply ceasing to resist.
ctx.shadow: Hidden beneath may be a habit of self-sacrifice that expects reward, or a comfort in being stuck because it spares you from deciding. Notice whether you are waiting for life or hiding from it. The calm face of the Pendu is genuine; make sure yours is too.
ctx.foundation: At the root lies a sacrifice or a suspension, something given up or put on hold. The situation rests on a necessary pause, one that is quietly changing your perspective from the inside out. Like a fruit hanging on the branch, it cannot be hurried.
ctx.gift: Your gift is the ability to see what others miss by looking from an unusual angle. You can wait without despair and let things ripen in their own time. Hidden help comes from stillness, dreams and insights that arrive when you stop chasing them.

name: XIII · The Nameless Arcanum
title: L'Arcane sans nom (traditionally Death)
imagery: A pale, flesh-coloured skeleton strides across dark earth, sweeping a long scythe with a yellow handle and a red blade through the ground. Around his feet hands and feet push up from the soil among blue and yellow shoots, and two heads lie at the bottom, one of them crowned. The card bears its number XIII but no name, and that silence is its teaching: this is the great clearing that cuts away what is finished, so that new growth can rise from the very same earth.
meaning: The Nameless Arcanum is the card of deep transformation, and in the Marseille tradition it is the great reaper who mows the field so it can be sown again. Nothing here is about literal doom: it is about the end of a form, a habit, a role or a chapter that has done its work. The skeleton is what remains when everything superfluous is stripped away, the essential structure of who you are. Notice the new shoots springing up in the black soil, and that even a crown falls before this blade: no attachment is too grand to be released. Let the cut be clean, and you will find yourself lighter, truer and ready to grow again.
numerology: Thirteen comes after the completed twelve, so it breaks the cycle open; one plus three makes four, the solid ground that is cleared and prepared for a new foundation.
affirmation: I release what is finished and make room for new life.

ctx.past: A significant ending shaped your present: a relationship, a role, a home or an old version of yourself was cleared away. It may have hurt, but it stripped you down to essentials. What grew afterward grew from that cleared ground, and you are stronger for having passed through it.
ctx.present: You are in the middle of a profound transformation, and the heart of the matter is letting the old form go. Something has reached its natural end. Resisting the scythe only prolongs the discomfort; working with it lets you clear the field and see what wants to sprout in its place.
ctx.future: A major change is coming, a clean break or a turning of the page that makes way for something new. It is not a loss without purpose: it is a harvest and a clearing. Expect to emerge leaner, clearer and closer to the bones of what truly matters to you.
ctx.challenge: The obstacle is fear of change and clinging to what has already ended. You may be holding onto a dead situation because the unknown feels worse. Or you may be cutting too harshly, slashing at everything. Let the reaper work, but with care, and keep what is truly alive.
ctx.advice: Make the cut. Clear out the drawer, end the commitment that drains you, close the chapter consciously. Strip things back to essentials and ask what is really living here. Once the ground is cleared, plant something deliberately in the space you have made.
ctx.self: You may feel stripped bare, in the middle of becoming someone new without knowing yet who that is. Honour the courage this takes. You are not falling apart; you are shedding what was never truly yours so that your real shape can show.
ctx.others: Others may see you as changed, more direct, less willing to tolerate what drains you. Or people around you are going through upheaval and endings of their own. The environment itself may be restructuring, and those who adapt with honesty will flourish.
ctx.hopes: You may long for a fresh start and a clean slate, yet fear the ending that has to come first. Endings carry grief and relief together. Notice that what you dread losing may be exactly what has been keeping you from the life you hope for.
ctx.love: In love, the Nameless Arcanum signals a deep transformation. A relationship may move into an entirely new phase, old patterns may need to end so the bond can be reborn, or a finished connection may need to be released with gratitude. Truthfulness clears the way for something real.
ctx.work: At work, a job, project or way of doing things may be ending or radically restructuring. Clear the clutter, cut what is not productive and focus on the core of what you offer. This is a powerful time to reinvent your path from the essentials up.
ctx.spirit: Spirit speaks of death and rebirth as the rhythm of all living things. Your guides remind you that every ending in nature feeds a new beginning. Trust the cycle, and let this clearing be a sacred act rather than something to fear.
ctx.release: Release what is already over: the role you have outgrown, the hope that something finished will revive, the identity you are clinging to out of habit. Let the crown fall if you must. What remains will be your true foundation.
ctx.shadow: Hidden beneath may be a fear of loss so strong it keeps you from living fully, or a secret wish for change you have not dared to admit. Look at what you are keeping alive only out of fear, and what you are quietly ready to let go.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation lies an ending or a transformation, either one that has happened and is still being absorbed, or one that is needed and long overdue. Everything else grows from accepting that something must be cleared.
ctx.gift: Your gift is the power of renewal. You can let go, start over and rebuild from the essentials, and that resilience is rare. Hidden help comes through the freedom that follows every honest ending, and the new shoots already rising in the soil.

name: XIV · Temperance
title: Tempérance
imagery: A winged angel with blue hair and a small golden flower at her brow pours a stream from a blue vase held high into a red vase held low, the liquid running diagonally across her body. She wears a blue gown with red sleeves and a broad red drape, and stands on yellow ground with small green tufts, her face turned gently down toward her work. The two colours of the vases speak of opposites being mingled, the flowing stream of life energy passed patiently from one vessel to another, and the angel’s quiet focus of healing that takes its time.
meaning: Tempérance (numbered XIIII on the Conver card) follows the great clearing of the Nameless Arcanum, and she brings the gentle work of reintegration. Here an angel, a guide and protector, mixes the waters of spirit and matter, heart and mind, until they flow together in a living balance. This is the card of healing, moderation and the right measure of everything. She asks you to slow down, blend what seemed opposed and let life circulate freely between you and others. Her magic is patient, steady and quiet, and what she touches is gradually restored.
numerology: Fourteen is ten plus four: a new cycle built on solid ground, and its sum, five, is the bridge to a higher understanding, here expressed as the flowing link between two vessels.
affirmation: I let life flow through me in its right measure.

ctx.past: A period of healing or careful balancing laid the ground for where you are now. Perhaps you found a middle way, mended a rift or slowly recovered your strength. That patient, steady work still flows beneath your situation and gives it a calm, solid base.
ctx.present: You are being asked to blend, balance and pace yourself. The heart of the matter is finding the right mixture: work and rest, giving and receiving, head and heart. Like the angel pouring between her vases, you are not choosing one side but letting both mingle into something new.
ctx.future: Harmony is coming. Expect healing, a reconciliation, or a period when things begin to flow more smoothly after tension. Progress will be gradual rather than dramatic, but it will be lasting. A protective influence, a guide or a helpful person, may appear right on time.
ctx.challenge: The obstacle is imbalance: too much of one thing, too little of another, or impatience that wants instant results. It may also be bland compromise that waters everything down. Temperance asks for the right measure, not the least offensive one, so look for the mixture that truly nourishes.
ctx.advice: Slow down and find your middle path. Combine approaches rather than choosing sides, take things one careful pour at a time and tend to your body and nerves. Small, consistent adjustments will do more now than any grand gesture.
ctx.self: You appear as a calm presence, someone able to soothe and harmonise. You may be learning to moderate your own extremes. Trust your gift for balance, and remember to pour some of that gentle care back into your own vessel.
ctx.others: Others see you as a peacemaker or a steadying influence. Alternatively, someone around you is acting as a guardian angel: a healer, a mediator, a patient friend. The environment favours cooperation and tact over force.
ctx.hopes: You hope for peace, health and a life that flows rather than lurches. You may fear that balance is impossible or that you will always swing between extremes. Temperance reassures you: harmony is not a fixed state but a practice, and you are already learning it.
ctx.love: In love, this card blesses harmony, mutual adjustment and a relationship where both people blend without losing themselves. It favours healing after conflict and quiet, steady affection. For singles, a gentle, compatible connection grows best when allowed to develop slowly.
ctx.work: At work, Temperance favours collaboration, mediation and combining skills or resources in creative ways. Pace your workload to avoid burnout. In money matters, moderation pays: steady budgeting and balanced choices bring better results than risky leaps.
ctx.spirit: Spirit speaks through your guardian angel, reminding you that you are accompanied and cared for. The message is one of alchemy: the ordinary and the sacred mingling in your daily life. Trust the slow, healing flow that moves between your soul and your body.
ctx.release: Release extremes, all-or-nothing thinking and the urge to hurry your own healing. Let go of the belief that you must pick a side. Pour out what has gone stale and let fresh water fill the vessel.
ctx.shadow: Hidden beneath may be a habit of keeping the peace at the cost of your own truth, or a fear of strong feelings that makes you dilute everything. Balance is alive; check that yours is not simply avoidance.
ctx.foundation: At the root lies a need for balance and integration, two elements of your life that must learn to flow together. The situation rests on finding the right proportions and allowing time for them to settle.
ctx.gift: Your gift is the power to heal and harmonise. You can bring opposites together, calm a tense room and turn a difficult mix into something nourishing. Hidden help comes from patience, gentle care and an unseen guardian watching over you.

name: XV · The Devil
title: Le Diable
