imagery: A strange, playful Devil with blue bat-like wings, golden antlers and both breasts and blue legs stands on a red pedestal, one hand raised with open palm and the other gripping a long staff. Below him two small horned imps in red caps stand naked, loosely tied by cords around their necks to his pedestal, and both of them seem quite at ease. The loose cords show that these bonds could be slipped off at any time; the mingling of features in the Devil himself shows the wild, undivided power of instinct and desire that lives in the depths of every person.
meaning: Le Diable in the Marseille tradition is not only the tempter but the great reservoir of raw vitality: sexuality, ambition, money, creative fire and everything instinctive that we may have learned to fear. His energy is enormous, and the card asks how you are using it. Where it becomes compulsion, attachment or a bond you know is unhealthy, he shows you the cord around your neck and reminds you it is loose enough to lift off. Where it is honoured consciously, the same power becomes passion, charisma and the courage to want. Look your desires in the face without shame, keep what fuels you and free yourself from what binds you.
numerology: Fifteen is ten plus five, and its sum is six, the number of pleasure and desire; here that pleasure is brought down into the depths of matter, instinct and the unconscious.
affirmation: I own my desires, and nothing owns me.

ctx.past: A strong attachment, a temptation or a powerful passion shaped what is happening now. Perhaps a habit, a relationship or an ambition held you tightly for a time. Recognising that influence, without shame, frees you to keep its fire and leave its chains.
ctx.present: Powerful desires and attachments are at the heart of the matter. Something has a grip on you: a person, a craving, a fear, a promise of reward. Notice the cord around the imps’ necks: it is loose. Ask what you are really getting from this bond, and whether you still choose it.
ctx.future: A period of intense energy is coming, possibly temptation, a magnetic attraction or a chance at money or power. It can be thrilling and fruitful if you stay awake. Enjoy what is truly life-giving and keep a clear eye on anything that wants more of you than you mean to give.
ctx.challenge: The obstacle is compulsion: a habit, dependency or dynamic that keeps you tied even though part of you wants out. It may be materialism, jealousy or a fear that you can’t live without something. The Devil demands honesty: name the bond clearly, and you have already begun to lift it off.
ctx.advice: Look your desires straight in the eye. Acknowledge what you really want, including the parts you were taught to hide, and use that energy deliberately. Then, gently and firmly, loosen one cord that no longer serves you. Pleasure and freedom can live together.
ctx.self: You may be feeling your own power, magnetism or hunger very strongly right now. Or you may feel trapped by something you cannot quite name. Both are the same raw energy. Own it rather than fear it, and you become the one holding the staff.
ctx.others: Others may find you intense, charismatic or a bit intimidating. Alternatively, someone in your environment exerts a strong pull, through charm, money or manipulation. Notice who benefits from the bonds around you, and step back where the dynamic feels possessive.
ctx.hopes: You may hope for passion, success, money or the freedom to indulge. You may also fear your own appetites, or fear being controlled by someone else’s. Both reveal how much life force is waiting in you, ready to be directed wisely.
ctx.love: In love, the Devil brings intense attraction and strong physical chemistry. It can mean a deeply passionate bond, or a relationship tangled in jealousy, possessiveness or dependency. Enjoy the fire, but make sure both of you are choosing to stay, not merely tied in place.
ctx.work: At work, this card points to ambition, money and power, possibly a lucrative but demanding situation. It can bring real drive and success. Watch for golden handcuffs, unhealthy workplaces or deals that compromise your values. Charge what you are worth, with integrity.
ctx.spirit: Spirit asks you to bring light into the cellar. What you have repressed holds enormous creative energy. Your guides encourage you to honour the body, the instincts and desire as part of the sacred, and to free your spirit from anything that keeps it in bondage.
ctx.release: Release the habit, fear or relationship that keeps you on a cord. Let go of shame about your desires, too, because shame binds as tightly as indulgence. Slip the loop over your head and walk away a little lighter.
ctx.shadow: Hidden beneath may be a craving you won’t admit, a fear of your own power, or a payoff you get from staying stuck. Ask honestly what the bond gives you. Shadow work here is liberating, not dangerous.
ctx.foundation: At the root lies desire, attachment or a hunger for security, pleasure or power. The situation rests on these strong instinctive forces, and seeing them clearly is the first step to choosing freely. The cord is real, but so is your hand that can lift it.
ctx.gift: Your gift is raw vitality: passion, sensuality, ambition and the courage to want. Used consciously, this energy can create, seduce and succeed. Hidden help may come through honesty about your desires, and the discovery that you were freer than you thought.

name: XVI · The House of God
title: La Maison Dieu
imagery: A brick tower with three windows is struck at its top by a great plume of yellow and red flame coming from the upper corner, and its golden crown is knocked loose like a lid. Two figures tumble out, one falling head-first past the tower wall and one already on the ground, hand reaching to touch the earth, while red, blue, yellow and white balls rain down through the sky among green tufts of grass. In the Marseille reading this is the House of God, a structure flung open by heavenly fire: the crown lifted off lets light in and lets the inhabitants out, and the coloured balls are blessings showering down like a celebration.
meaning: La Maison Dieu is the card of sudden opening. Something that was closed, rigid or too tall for its foundations is struck by a flash of heavenly energy, and what was shut inside is set free. The Marseille tradition sees here not doom but liberation: the crown lifting like a lid, the figures returning to the earth with their hands reaching for the ground, the sky full of colour. It may come as a shock, a revelation, a breakthrough or a burst of joy that cannot be contained. Let the old walls go, come back to solid ground and feel the freedom of the open air. What collapses was a prison; what remains is real.
numerology: Sixteen is ten plus six, and its sum is seven, the number of action in the world; here action arrives as a burst of energy that breaks open whatever has become too enclosed.
affirmation: When the walls fall, I step out into the light.

ctx.past: A sudden event shook the structure of your life: a revelation, an upheaval, a surprise that broke something open. As unsettling as it was, it freed you from a situation that had grown too confining. The ground you stand on now was cleared by that lightning.
ctx.present: Something is being cracked open right now. The heart of the matter is a breakthrough, perhaps a truth coming out, a plan falling apart or a sudden burst of energy that refuses to be contained. Don’t cling to the falling bricks; feel for the ground and notice the air rushing in.
ctx.future: An unexpected change is coming, swift and liberating. It may surprise you, shake loose an outdated arrangement or reveal something hidden. Though it may feel abrupt, it opens the door to a freer, more honest life, and colourful blessings tend to follow in its wake.
ctx.challenge: The obstacle is a structure that has grown too rigid or too proud: a belief, an ego or a way of life that no longer has room to breathe. If you won’t open the door, the lightning may. The challenge is to let pride fall gracefully and come back to earth.
ctx.advice: Open up before life opens you. Speak the truth that needs speaking, leave the situation you have outgrown, and break the routine that has become a cell. Welcome the jolt as a release, then put your hands on the ground and rebuild only what is genuine.
ctx.self: You may feel shaken up, or bursting with energy that your old life cannot contain. Something in you wants out. This is not a breakdown but a breakthrough: the crown is lifting off a version of yourself that was too small.
ctx.others: Others may see you as unpredictable or as the one who breaks the silence. Alternatively, the environment is in upheaval: reorganisation, scandal or sudden news. Those who stay flexible and honest will find themselves freed rather than flattened.
ctx.hopes: You may hope for a breakthrough, a dramatic change or a release from pressure. At the same time you may fear the collapse of something you depend on. Both hopes and fears point to an opening that is already on its way.
ctx.love: In love, the House of God can bring a sudden revelation, an argument that clears the air, or a passion that bursts out unexpectedly. It shakes up stale patterns. A relationship built on honesty will grow freer; one built on illusion may need to open its doors.
ctx.work: At work, expect sudden change: a restructure, an unexpected opportunity, or a project or plan that has to be completely rethought. It may be unsettling, but it frees you from what was unsustainable. Keep your foundations practical and stay ready to move.
ctx.spirit: Spirit arrives as a flash of illumination. Your guides may be breaking open a belief or ego structure so that grace can pour in. This is an awakening, the divine fire touching the house of the self and showering it with light.
ctx.release: Release the need to keep everything under control and the walls you built to feel safe. Let go of pride, pretence and the high tower of expectations. What falls away now was meant to fall.
ctx.shadow: Hidden beneath may be a pressure building quietly: suppressed anger, unspoken truth or a dream you have been too cautious to follow. Pay attention before it bursts. Gentle release is kinder than a lightning strike.
ctx.foundation: At the root lies a structure that could not hold: something built on shaky ground or closed too tightly. The situation rests on a necessary breaking open that clears the way for a more authentic foundation.
ctx.gift: Your gift is the courage to break free and the resilience to land on your feet. You can see through illusions and welcome change. Hidden help comes as sudden clarity, an unexpected opening and the blessings that rain down after the storm.

name: XVII · The Star
title: L'Étoile
imagery: Under eight stars, one large yellow and red star surrounded by seven smaller ones in yellow, blue and red, a naked woman with long blue hair kneels with one knee on the earth and one foot by the water. She pours from two red jugs, one into the blue river and one onto the land, while a black bird perches on a tree behind her and a small green tree rises on the hillside. Her nakedness speaks of authenticity with nothing to hide, her two jugs of endless giving to both feeling and matter, and the bird on the tree of the soul awakening to sing.
meaning: L’Étoile is the card of hope and of finding your place in the universe. After the opening of the House of God, a woman kneels under a sky full of stars, utterly herself, and pours out her gifts with nothing held back. In the Marseille tradition she nourishes the river and the earth at once, giving from an inner source that never runs dry. This card brings renewal, healing, inspiration and the quiet certainty that you are guided. It asks you to be truthful and unguarded, to trust that what you give returns, and to follow the light that is uniquely yours.
numerology: Seventeen is ten plus seven, and its sum is eight, the number of perfection: here that perfection flows outward as generosity, harmony between heaven and earth, and receptivity to cosmic guidance.
affirmation: I trust my light and pour it freely into the world.

ctx.past: A time of healing or renewed hope prepared the ground for today. Perhaps after a difficult period you found your faith again or reconnected with who you really are. That gentle, starry season still nourishes you, and its inspiration flows beneath everything now.
ctx.present: You are kneeling under a sky full of stars, and the heart of the matter is hope. Something is being renewed. Be open, be honest and let yourself receive as well as give. You are in the right place, and the light you seek is already shining on you.
ctx.future: Healing and inspiration are coming. Expect renewed optimism, a sign or a stroke of good fortune that shows you are on the right path. Opportunities flow from being authentically yourself. Brighter days are not just a hope; they are on their way.
ctx.challenge: The obstacle may be giving yourself away without refilling, or holding onto hope so lightly that you never act on it. You may also feel too exposed to share your gifts. The Star asks you to trust and to be seen, yet also to keep your feet on the earth.
ctx.advice: Be yourself, completely. Share your gifts generously, nurture the people and projects that matter and do something each day that renews your spirit. Make a wish, set an intention, and then pour your energy toward it as the woman pours her water.
ctx.self: You are radiant, open and honest, perhaps more vulnerable than usual, and that vulnerability is your beauty. You may be finding your purpose. Trust the guiding star within you and let yourself shine without apology.
ctx.others: Others see you as inspiring, kind and genuine. Someone in your environment may also be a source of hope, a mentor, healer or artist. The atmosphere is supportive and sincere, and generosity is likely to be returned.
ctx.hopes: You hope for healing, a brighter future and a sense of purpose. You may fear disappointment or that your hopes are naive. The Star answers gently: hope is not foolish but a form of wisdom, and your wishes are worth trusting.
ctx.love: In love, the Star brings tenderness, healing and a bond where you can be fully yourself. It favours honest openness and a relationship that feels like a gift. Singles may meet someone who inspires them, or rediscover their own worth first.
ctx.work: At work, the Star favours creative, humanitarian or inspired projects and recognition for your unique talent. Share your work generously and let it be seen. Prospects are bright; trust your vision and keep pouring steady effort into it.
ctx.spirit: Spirit speaks clearly: you are guided and protected by the stars. Your guides invite you to trust, to pray or meditate under the open sky and to remember your soul’s purpose. Grace is flowing toward you as freely as water.
ctx.release: Release cynicism, despair and the belief that you must hide your true self to be accepted. Let go of anything that makes you feel unworthy of hope. Lay down your armour and let the starlight touch you.
ctx.shadow: Hidden beneath may be a fear of being truly seen, or a tendency to give so much you forget to receive. You might also be waiting for a sign when the sign is already in front of you.
ctx.foundation: At the root lies hope, faith and an authentic connection to your own nature. The situation rests on the quiet trust that the universe supports you, and on your willingness to give from the heart.
ctx.gift: Your gift is your light: authenticity, generosity and the ability to inspire. You heal simply by being yourself. Hidden help comes from the universe, from intuition and from the open-hearted people who are drawn to your star.

name: XVIII · The Moon
title: La Lune
imagery: A blue moon with a face in profile shines inside a ring of red and blue rays, and coloured drops rise from the earth toward her. Below, two pale dogs lift their heads and howl at her between two yellow towers, while from a deep blue pool a dark crayfish rises toward the surface. The drops drawn upward show the moon pulling everything toward her, the dogs our tamed and untamed instincts calling to the mystery, and the crayfish something ancient emerging from the depths of the unconscious.
meaning: La Lune is the great card of the night, of intuition, dreams and the deep feminine. In the Marseille tradition she is receptive and magnetic, drawing everything toward her as the tide is drawn, and she rules the realm where things are felt before they are understood. This can be a time of confusion, when the path is uncertain and imagination plays tricks. It is also a time of profound inner knowing, when dreams, emotions and instincts carry messages you cannot reach by daylight. Honour your intuition, move slowly, and let what rises from the depths come to the surface in its own time.
numerology: Eighteen is ten plus eight, and its sum is nine, the number of crisis and inner wisdom: a deep turning inward where answers come from feeling rather than reasoning.
affirmation: I trust what I feel, even when I cannot yet see.

ctx.past: A time of uncertainty, dreams or deep feeling shaped where you are now. Perhaps something was unclear, or you navigated a period by instinct alone. Emotions from that time may still ripple beneath the surface and are worth gently acknowledging.
ctx.present: You are walking in moonlight. The heart of the matter is that not everything can be seen clearly yet. Trust your intuition more than appearances, notice your dreams and feelings, and let something rise from the depths at its own pace rather than forcing clarity.
ctx.future: A period of mystery and deep intuition lies ahead. Things may feel uncertain for a time, but this is a fertile darkness where dreams, creativity and inner knowing grow strong. What emerges from the depths will become clear when it is ready.
ctx.challenge: The obstacle is confusion, illusion or anxiety. You may be projecting fears onto the situation, or someone may be hiding the full picture. Don’t make final decisions in a fog. The Moon demands that you separate real intuition from worry dressed up as intuition.
ctx.advice: Listen inward. Keep a dream journal, take time alone, follow your gut and allow yourself to feel. Don’t rush toward certainty. Let your imagination and emotions guide you, while checking key facts before you act on them.
ctx.self: You are deeply sensitive and intuitive right now, perhaps more emotional or dreamy than usual. You may feel unsure of yourself. Honour this receptive state; you are picking up on far more than you realise.
ctx.others: Others may see you as mysterious, hard to read or deeply empathic. The environment itself may be unclear, with unspoken feelings, rumours or hidden motives. Move gently and trust what you sense about people beyond their words.
ctx.hopes: You may hope for clarity, or for the magic of dreams coming true. You may fear the unknown, deception or your own emotional depths. The Moon reminds you that darkness is not empty: it is full of potential waiting to be born.
ctx.love: In love, the Moon brings deep feeling, romance and intuition, but also uncertainty. Feelings may be strong yet unspoken, or you may be idealising someone. Trust your heart, communicate gently and let the relationship reveal itself over time.
ctx.work: At work, situations may be unclear or changing, and not all information may be on the table. Creative, artistic and intuitive work flourishes. Get clarity before signing anything, and let your imagination lead in projects that need vision.
ctx.spirit: Spirit speaks through dreams, symbols and intuition. Your guides are closer in the quiet hours of the night. This is a time to honour the mystery, the cycles of the moon and the wisdom of your own inner tides.
ctx.release: Release the need for everything to be explained right now. Let go of fears that grow in the dark, and of illusions you have been holding about yourself or someone else. Allow the moonlight to show what is real.
ctx.shadow: Hidden beneath may be old emotions, memories or fears rising from the depths like the crayfish from the pool. You might be deceiving yourself in some small way. Look gently into the water; what you find is part of you.
ctx.foundation: At the root lie feelings and instincts not yet fully understood: deep emotions, family patterns or dreams from long ago. The situation rests on these hidden currents, and working with them brings understanding. The dogs howl, the crayfish climbs: let them speak.
ctx.gift: Your gift is intuition, imagination and emotional depth. You can sense what others miss and navigate where there are no maps. Hidden help comes through dreams, signs, synchronicities and the wisdom of your own inner knowing.

name: XIX · The Sun
title: Le Soleil
imagery: A great golden sun with a human face blazes in the sky, ringed by wavy rays of red, blue, green and yellow between straight black ones, and coloured drops fall from it toward the earth. Beneath it, two twin-like children in blue loincloths stand together before a low yellow brick wall topped with red, one resting a hand on the other’s shoulder in friendship. The wall marks a protected, cultivated space, the falling drops are the sun’s gifts raining down, and the two children embody brotherhood, trust and the joy of sharing life with another.
meaning: Le Soleil (numbered XVIIII on the Conver card) is one of the brightest cards of the deck, and in the Marseille tradition it is the card of warmth, fraternity and new life. After the night of the Moon, everything is clear again, generous and full of light. The two children show that true happiness is shared: this is a card of friendship, partnership, love and support. It brings success, health, confidence and the simple, radiant joy of being alive. Let yourself enjoy it, be seen and offer your warmth to others.
numerology: Nineteen is ten plus nine, and its sum, ten, closes one cycle and opens another: the light of a new beginning built on all that has been learned.
affirmation: I shine, I share, and joy finds me.

ctx.past: A happy, sunlit time lies behind you: success, love, friendship or a burst of vitality. It gave you confidence and warmth that still sustain you. Remember how it felt; that light is still part of who you are and can be called upon again.
ctx.present: The sun is shining on you right now. The heart of the matter is joy, clarity and connection. Things are going well, or about to. Let yourself enjoy it, share it with those you love and allow your warmth to be seen without dimming yourself.
ctx.future: Bright times are coming: success, happiness, good health or a heartwarming connection. Plans come together and clarity arrives. Expect a time of growth and celebration, and a sense of being completely at home in your life.
ctx.challenge: The obstacle may be too much sun: overconfidence, burnout from constant activity, or forced positivity that refuses to look at anything difficult. You may also struggle to accept happiness. Let yourself shine, but rest in the shade when you need to.
ctx.advice: Step into the light. Be open, warm and generous. Spend time with friends, go outside, play and celebrate your wins. Collaborate with others; this is a card of partnership, and shared joy multiplies. Even a small shared pleasure counts today.
ctx.self: You are radiant and confident, or ready to become so. You may feel more like your true self than you have for a long time. Trust your light, express it freely and let your inner child out to play.
ctx.others: Others see you as warm, joyful and easy to be around. The environment is supportive and friendly, and a loyal friend or partner may stand beside you. This is a time of good company, mutual help and shared celebration.
ctx.hopes: You hope for happiness, success and connection. You may also fear that joy is fleeting or that you don’t deserve it. The Sun answers: you do, and light shared grows rather than diminishes. Let the sun’s drops fall on you too.
ctx.love: In love, the Sun brings happiness, warmth and a relationship built on friendship and trust. It favours couples who are true companions, as well as new love that feels easy and joyful. It can also point to good news about family or children.
ctx.work: At work, the Sun signals success, recognition and productive teamwork. Projects flourish and your talents shine. It is a favourable time for collaboration, launches and stepping forward. Financial matters tend to improve when you work openly and generously.
ctx.spirit: Spirit shines through as pure light and love. Your guides celebrate with you and remind you that joy is sacred. You are seen, warmed and supported; let gratitude open your heart even further. Turn your face upward like a flower and simply receive.
ctx.release: Release doubt, gloom and the habit of hiding your light. Let go of isolation and the belief that you must do everything alone. Step out from behind the wall and let the sun touch you.
ctx.shadow: Hidden beneath may be a fear of being truly seen, or a need for approval that drives your sunny face. Ask whether your joy is genuine or a performance. True warmth needs no audience. Let your light be real, not polished.
ctx.foundation: At the root lies vitality, love and a deep connection with another person or with life itself. The situation rests on warmth and trust, which make everything else possible. Like the two children standing shoulder to shoulder, you are not facing this alone, and the bond between you and others is the warm ground everything grows from.
ctx.gift: Your gift is radiance: optimism, warmth and the ability to make others feel welcome and alive. Hidden help comes through friends, partners and the simple goodness of the world in daylight. Your sunny presence is a medicine, and people instinctively gather around it.

name: XX · Judgement
title: Le Jugement
imagery: A golden-haired angel with red sleeves leans out from a swirl of blue cloud, ringed by red and yellow rays, and blows a long trumpet hung with a white banner marked by a golden cross. Below, three naked figures rise from a green tomb: a woman on the left and a bearded man on the right with hands joined in prayer, and between them a figure seen from behind, blue-headed, emerging from the earth. The trumpet is the call of the spirit, the cross the meeting of heaven and earth, and the risen figures a new being born from the union of feminine and masculine, answering the call.
meaning: Le Jugement is the card of awakening and of a calling you can no longer ignore. In the Marseille tradition it is less about being judged than about being called: the angel’s trumpet sounds and what was buried rises into new life. Here the two figures praying around the central one can be read as a family, or as the inner mother and father whose union gives birth to a new consciousness. This card brings rebirth, vocation, forgiveness and the sense that you are finally hearing your true purpose. Answer the call, rise from what has held you down and step into the life that is asking for you.
numerology: Twenty is two tens, a doubled completion: two cycles fulfilled, which opens onto a higher consciousness and a new level of being.
affirmation: I hear my calling, and I rise to answer it.

ctx.past: An awakening or turning point shaped where you are now. Perhaps you heard a call, made a life-changing decision or reconnected with something long buried. That moment of rising up still echoes, reminding you of who you became when you answered.
ctx.present: The trumpet is sounding now. The heart of the matter is an awakening: a calling, a realisation or a chance to begin again on a deeper level. Something long buried is rising. Listen closely and allow yourself to respond.
ctx.future: A powerful renewal is coming. Expect news, a calling, a reunion or a realisation that changes how you see your life. You will be invited to rise to a new level, and the path ahead will become clear as you answer.
ctx.challenge: The obstacle may be self-judgement, guilt or ignoring a calling out of fear. You may hear the trumpet but stay in the tomb, hesitant to change. The challenge is to forgive yourself and others so you are free to rise.
ctx.advice: Answer the call. Make the decision you have been circling, reach out to someone, return to a long-held dream or step into a role that calls you. Forgive what needs forgiving, and let yourself be reborn into something truer.
ctx.self: You are awakening, perhaps feeling called to a new purpose or seeing yourself with new clarity. Trust that inner voice. You are ready to rise and shine in a way you could not before. The blue-headed figure rising from the tomb is you.
ctx.others: Others may see you as transformed, inspired or newly committed. Alternatively, someone around you is calling you forward: family, a mentor, a community. Family matters may also be stirring, offering reunion and healing. Say yes to the gathering.
ctx.hopes: You hope for a fresh start, recognition and a clear sense of purpose. You may fear being judged, or fear that the call is too big for you. Judgement reminds you that the call comes because you are ready.
ctx.love: In love, this card brings renewal: a relationship rising to a new level, a reconciliation, or a reunion with someone from your past. It may be a calling to love more consciously. Old wounds can be forgiven and a deeper bond reborn.
ctx.work: At work, Judgement signals vocation, a calling to work that matters, or recognition after long effort. It favours career changes guided by your true purpose. Be ready to step forward when the opportunity sounds. The trumpet rarely sounds twice in the same way.
ctx.spirit: Spirit is calling loudly. Your guides are inviting you into a spiritual awakening, a moment of grace and purpose. Listen to the trumpet in your heart; you are being asked to rise into your full consciousness.
ctx.release: Release guilt, regret and old judgements of yourself or others. Let go of what has kept you buried. Step out of the tomb and leave behind the heavy past. Like the figures rising from the green tomb, you can lift yourself out of an old story and stand up, bare and new, in the open air.
ctx.shadow: Hidden beneath may be a calling you are afraid to hear, or a harsh inner critic that keeps you small. Notice where you judge yourself unfairly, and where fear masks itself as caution. The angel is calling you, not condemning you.
ctx.foundation: At the root lies a calling, a deep desire to live with purpose, or family history waiting to be healed. The situation rests on this awakening, and responding to it changes everything. The trumpet has been sounding for a while; you are only now hearing it.
ctx.gift: Your gift is the power of rebirth and the ability to hear your calling clearly. You can rise from what once held you down and inspire others to do the same. Hidden help comes through messages, mentors and moments of sudden clarity.

name: XXI · The World
title: Le Monde
imagery: A naked figure, lightly draped with a scarf, dances inside an oval wreath of red, yellow and blue leaves tied at top and bottom with red bands, a wand in one hand and a small flask in the other, one leg crossed behind the other. In the four corners stand an angel in blue with a red cap, an eagle with a halo, a pale ox and a lion, each looking toward the centre. The wreath is the shape of a womb or an egg of the world, the four creatures are the elements and the four directions in harmony, and the dancer is the soul fully realised, free and joyful at the centre of it all.
meaning: Le Monde is the last numbered card of the Marseille Majors, the card of completion, fulfilment and wholeness. Everything has come together: the four elements around the edges, the living wreath and the dancing figure at the centre who is finally free to be fully herself. It signals success, the end of a cycle well lived and a sense of being at home in the world. It also hints at a new beginning, because the dance never truly ends. Celebrate what you have accomplished, enjoy the sense of integration and open your arms to the wider world.
numerology: Twenty-one is the highest numbered card of the Marseille Majors: twenty plus one, a new beginning born from total completion, and its sum, three, is the creative expression of everything integrated.
affirmation: I am whole, and I dance at the centre of my life.

ctx.past: A cycle came to a successful close: a goal achieved, a journey completed or a deep sense of wholeness reached. That fulfilment still supports you, and the confidence it gave you is part of your foundation now.
ctx.present: You are at the centre of the wreath right now. The heart of the matter is completion and integration: things are coming together, perhaps better than you expected. Celebrate this moment and feel how far you have come.
ctx.future: Fulfilment is coming: success, a goal reached, a cycle completed with grace. It may also bring travel, new horizons and a sense of belonging in the wider world. This ending carries the seed of an exciting new beginning.
ctx.challenge: The obstacle may be a reluctance to finish, holding onto the last step instead of closing the circle. Or you may chase perfection so that nothing ever feels complete. The World asks you to recognise when enough is enough, and dance.
ctx.advice: Close the circle. Finish what you started, celebrate your achievements and take stock of everything you have integrated. Then lift your eyes to the horizon: travel, expand and share your gifts with the world. The dancer holds her wand lightly; so can you.
ctx.self: You feel, or are becoming, whole and at ease in your own skin. You have integrated many parts of yourself. Enjoy this confidence and let your joy be visible; you have earned your place at the centre.
ctx.others: Others see you as accomplished, balanced and free. The environment is supportive and harmonious, and you may be widely recognised for your work. International connections, communities or a wider audience may be part of the picture.
ctx.hopes: You hope for fulfilment, success and a sense of belonging. You may fear the end of a cycle or the emptiness that can follow achievement. The World assures you that every completion opens into a new dance.
ctx.love: In love, the World brings fulfilment and harmony: a relationship that feels whole, a commitment or a milestone reached together. It favours partners who support each other’s freedom. Singles may meet someone while travelling or feeling deeply at home in themselves.
ctx.work: At work, this card signals success, completion of a major project and recognition. It favours international ventures, expansion and roles that let you use all your talents. Celebrate the achievement, then set your sights on the next horizon.
ctx.spirit: Spirit speaks of unity and wholeness. Your guides celebrate your journey and remind you that you are part of the great dance of life. This is a moment of grace, when the soul feels at home in the cosmos.
ctx.release: Release the need to keep striving when you have already arrived. Let go of the chapter that is complete, with gratitude. Step out of the wreath when it is time to begin anew. The wreath is open at its ties, after all.
ctx.shadow: Hidden beneath may be a fear of completion, a worry about what comes next or a sense that you cannot enjoy success. Notice if you keep moving the finish line. Allow yourself to arrive. The dance is meant to be enjoyed now.
ctx.foundation: At the root lies a long journey of growth and integration, all the lessons that have brought you here. The situation rests on wholeness earned through experience. Like the four creatures in the corners, every element of your life has a place in this picture, and each one has helped bring you to the centre.
ctx.gift: Your gift is wholeness: the ability to bring everything together and move through life with grace. Hidden help comes from the harmony of the elements, the support of the world around you and the freedom you have won.

name: Ace of Batons
title: As de Bâtons
imagery: A hand emerges from a scalloped blue-and-white cloud ringed with spikes and grips an enormous green club, knotted and studded with red stumps where branches were cut away. Flame-like drops of yellow, red, blue and white rain all around it. The pruned stumps show wild force shaped by a choice, and the falling drops are the sparks this energy throws off into the world.
meaning: The Ace of Batons is the whole forest of Fire packed into one living club: pure desire, creative drive and the will to live, still uncarved. In the Marseille tradition the Ace is total potential, so this is energy you hold rather than energy you have already spent. The cut stumps say the trunk was shaped, not tamed; wildness has been given a direction. It favours beginnings that come from the gut and the belly: a project, a passion, a physical renewal, a surge of sexual or creative vitality. Take hold of it with the same firm grip as the hand from the cloud, and let the sparks fly where they will.
numerology: One is the seed and the whole in a single form: everything the suit can become, gathered and waiting to be used.
affirmation: I hold my own fire firmly and it lights my way.

ctx.past: Somewhere behind this situation lies a single surge of desire or courage, the moment you grabbed the club and decided to want something. That raw spark set everything in motion, and its heat still runs underneath, even if the first excitement has cooled.
ctx.present: Fresh fire is in your hand right now. A wish, an idea or a physical burst of energy has arrived whole and unshaped, and the heart of the matter is that you have real power to start. Feel the weight of it, then decide where to aim it.
ctx.future: A strong new impulse is on its way: an offer, an inspiration or a return of appetite for life. It will feel like sparks raining from a cloud. Be ready to grasp it quickly, because this kind of opening rewards the person who moves while it is still hot.
ctx.challenge: Too much fire with no channel burns out or burns others. The block may be impatience, restless wanting, or starting ten things and finishing none. The Ace asks you to prune, as the stumps on this club show, so that your force runs through one strong trunk.
ctx.advice: Pick one burning desire and commit your energy to it now. Take a bold first step that your body can feel: move, make, speak, sign up. Don’t wait for a perfect plan; the plan grows from the act.
ctx.self: You feel charged, eager and a little untamed. Something in you wants to create, compete or simply live more fully. Trust that vitality instead of apologising for it; it is your natural strength at this moment.
ctx.others: People around you sense heat and drive in you, perhaps more than you realise. Or someone in your world is the spark-carrier, a bold friend or collaborator whose enthusiasm can light up a stalled project if you let them in.
ctx.hopes: You long to feel alive and passionate again, to begin something that is truly yours. You may also fear the size of that fire and what it would cost to follow it. The hand in the cloud reminds you that you can hold more than you think.
ctx.love: In love this is attraction with real heat: a new spark, desire returning, or a bold first move. It favours honesty about what you want, body and heart together. In an existing bond, rekindle play, flirtation and shared adventure.
ctx.work: At work it signals a launch, a fresh idea with stamina behind it, or a new role that fires you up. Energy and enthusiasm are your capital now. Give the idea a clear first form before its sparks scatter.
ctx.spirit: Spirit speaks through the life force itself. Your guides point to the sacred fire in your body and your creativity, the same green sap that pushes up the club. Treat your passion as a prayer and let it rise.
ctx.release: Let go of the fear that your desire is too much, too loud or too selfish. Release old dead branches too: projects and habits that only drain the sap. Clear them so the living wood can grow.
ctx.shadow: Beneath the surface may be anger or unused drive you have kept clenched for a long time. Unexpressed fire turns into frustration. Ask where you have been holding back your strength, and what it wants to build.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this matter lies desire, plain and powerful. Someone wanted something badly enough to reach out of the cloud and seize the club with a bare hand. Understanding that original want, and whose it really was, explains much of what has grown from it since.
ctx.gift: Your gift is vitality: the capacity to begin again with full force. Hidden help comes through your body, your instincts and your courage. When you act from that place, the whole forest stands behind you.

name: Two of Batons
title: Deux de Bâtons
imagery: Two long yellow batons with black iron tips cross in a tall X, bound with red rings and wrapped in blue where they meet. Flowers open above and below on slim stems, and red leaves with curling blue tips spread from the centre toward the edges. The two staffs lean on each other like partners, and the budding flowers show that something is growing between them but has not yet fully bloomed.
meaning: The Two of Batons is fire gathering in the dark before it acts. In Marseille numerology two is accumulation and gestation: the impulse of the Ace is now doubled and stored, building pressure. The two staffs cross and support each other, so this card often describes a partnership, an alliance or an inner pairing of desire and will. Nothing is wasted here, but nothing is launched yet either. Trust the slow build and use this time to gather resources, test agreements and let your intention mature until it is ready to break into flower.
numerology: Two is the number of gestation and accumulation, the closed, receptive phase where energy is stored and paired before it can act.
affirmation: I gather my strength patiently, and my fire grows.

ctx.past: An earlier alliance or a stretch of quiet preparation shaped where you are now. You were storing energy, waiting for the right partner or the right moment, and that slow gestation gave you more strength than it seemed to at the time. You are drawing on that saved-up fire today.
ctx.present: You are in the incubation phase. Two forces, two people or two desires lean against each other like the crossed staffs on this card, and the heat between them is building. The heart of the matter is learning to hold that tension patiently instead of forcing it into action too soon.
ctx.future: A partnership, pact or agreement is forming, and with it a reserve of energy for the next step. Expect a season of planning and quiet growth rather than fireworks. The flowers at the top and bottom of this card are still in bud, and they will open when their time comes.
ctx.challenge: Gathering can turn into stalling. The obstacle may be endless preparation, a fear of committing, or a rivalry in which two strong wills simply hold each other in place. Ask honestly whether you are building strength right now, or using the waiting as a comfortable place to hide from the leap.
ctx.advice: Use this pause on purpose. Gather your tools, your allies and your information, and get clear on what you and any partner truly want. Make a pact, with yourself or with another, then let the plan ripen in private. Action will come with far more force for this patience.
ctx.self: You feel full of potential that has not yet found its outlet, a little like a coiled spring. You may be weighing two paths or two sides of yourself, unsure which to back. Honour the waiting, because it is not weakness but concentration, the fire banking itself for later.
ctx.others: Others may find you reserved or hard to read at the moment, keeping your cards close to your chest. Or someone around you wants to join forces with you. Look carefully at whether their fire would cross yours in support, as these two batons do, or simply compete with it.
ctx.hopes: You hope for a strong ally, or for your hidden talents to be recognised at last. You may also fear that the waiting will never end, or that sharing your fire means losing some of it. Notice that both staffs on this card stand taller precisely because they cross.
ctx.love: In love this shows two people drawn together with growing desire that is still private and unspoken. Attraction is building beneath the surface like heat under ash. Let it deepen naturally, and when the moment feels right, talk openly about whether you both want the same thing from it.
ctx.work: At work this card favours partnerships, joint ventures, contracts and research before a launch. Your energy is being stored for a bigger push later on. Draft the agreements, settle the terms and test the idea quietly, rather than rushing something half-formed in front of the world.
ctx.spirit: Spirit invites you into the fertile dark where seeds sprout long before anyone sees them. Your guides remind you that stillness can be a form of power. Sit with your desire in meditation or quiet ritual, and let it gather strength without needing to prove itself yet.
ctx.release: Let go of the pressure to show results right away, and of the belief that rest means failure. Loosen any partnership that keeps you locked in a stalemate rather than helping you grow. Not every crossing of wills is a creative one, and you may outgrow some of them.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be a power struggle you have not yet named, or a desire you are keeping secret even from yourself. Ask what you are really storing up energy for. Fire held too long in the dark can turn into resentment instead of creation, so look at it kindly.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation lies a pairing: two people, two wishes or two forces meeting at a crossing point and bound together. Everything else grows from how those forces support or resist one another, and from whether the knot at their centre is woven with trust.
ctx.gift: Your gift is the ability to hold power quietly. You can build, wait and endure without wasting your fire on show. Hidden help may come through a partner who steadies you, or simply from your own instinct for timing, which knows better than your impatience when to move.

name: Three of Batons
title: Trois de Bâtons
imagery: Two batons cross in an X while a third rises straight up the centre, all three bound by red rings and gathered by a blue wrap where they meet. Small yellow flowers sprout from the crossing on either side, and red leaves with blue curling tips reach out toward the borders. The upright staff is the new force that bursts out of the pair, and the flowers mark the first visible bloom of energy.
meaning: The Three of Batons is the moment fire breaks out of its shell. In the Marseille count, three is the explosion of the stored energy of two: young, enthusiastic and not yet sure of its direction. The upright central baton cuts through the crossing as if something long held has finally burst free. Expect breakthrough, new projects taking shape and a sense of fresh momentum, sometimes clumsy but always alive. Ride the wave and enjoy it, while keeping an eye on where the energy is actually going.
numerology: Three is the first creative explosion, the youthful burst that breaks out of gestation with plenty of force and little experience.
affirmation: I let my creative fire break free and find its path.

ctx.past: A breakthrough in the past set this whole situation in motion. Something you had been holding back finally burst out, an idea, a decision or a creative surge, much like the upright staff breaking through the crossing on this card. Its energy is still pushing things forward today.
ctx.present: Things are taking off. You are in the exciting first rush where stored energy breaks through and new shoots appear, the way little yellow blossoms sprout from this card’s centre. The heart of the matter is that momentum is on your side, even if you can’t yet see exactly where it leads.
ctx.future: Expect a burst of activity and growth ahead: a project springing to life, a new interest, a widening of your horizons. The coming phase will be lively, untidy and full of beginnings. Prepare to say yes often and to learn as you go, because experience will arrive through doing.
ctx.challenge: The shadow of three is enthusiasm that flares brightly and burns out fast. You may be starting things before thinking them through, or expecting one first burst to carry a whole project. Give your excitement a clear direction and a little structure so that it doesn’t fizzle into scattered sparks.
ctx.advice: Act on your enthusiasm now, while it is still hot. Show your work, share your idea or take the first public step, even if it feels a bit raw. Stay curious and flexible, and be ready to adjust your aim once you see what actually begins to grow.
ctx.self: You feel lively, eager and ready to show what you can do. Perhaps you are a beginner in this field, full of hope and more energy than technique. Let that youthful spirit lead for now, and trust that skill and judgement will catch up with you along the way.
ctx.others: Others see someone who is breaking out and coming alive, and some will be inspired by it while others find it a little overwhelming. Or a new, enthusiastic person is entering your circle and stirring things up. Either way, the old routine around you is being shaken loose.
ctx.hopes: You hope this new beginning will really take off and become something lasting. You may also fear looking naive, or that your excitement will run dry halfway. The upright staff at the heart of this card says the energy is real; it simply needs steady, regular care.
ctx.love: In love this is a fresh spark catching: an exciting phase of flirtation, or a relationship moving into a livelier, more playful chapter. Enjoy the rush and say how you feel. Let things grow at their own pace without pressing for promises before the shoots have had a chance to root.
ctx.work: At work, projects start moving, ideas find their first audience and openings to expand appear. This is a good moment to pitch, promote and experiment boldly. Sketch out the next stage as well, so that this first explosion of momentum turns into results you can build on.
ctx.spirit: Spirit is sending you a creative breakthrough. Your guides celebrate your willingness to grow and want you to feel the joy of new life pushing upward from within. Let your spiritual practice be playful and expressive for a while, through movement, song, making or simply wandering outdoors.
ctx.release: Let go of the idea that you must be an expert before you begin. Release the shell of old caution that once protected your idea in its gestation but now only confines it. Things that are ready to break out are healthier when you stop holding them in.
ctx.shadow: Hidden beneath your enthusiasm may be a fear that if you slow down even a little, the energy will vanish for good. Or impatience may be dressing itself up as passion. Notice whether you are moving out of joy, or out of a restless need to stay busy.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation lies a force that could no longer be contained. Desire that had been gathering for some time broke out of its shell and set everything moving. Understanding that original rush, and what it was reaching for, helps you steer what comes next.
ctx.gift: Your gift is fresh momentum and the courage to begin before you feel ready. Hidden help arrives through your own enthusiasm, which opens doors and draws people toward you. Your spark is contagious, and others will gladly add their fuel to a fire that is already burning.

name: Four of Batons
title: Quatre de Bâtons
imagery: Four batons cross in a sturdy X, two by two, their middles woven together in a blue lattice and banded with red rings. A yellow flower crowns the top and another blooms at the base, while red leaves with blue tips frame the crossing on both sides. The paired staffs make a square, balanced frame, and the flowers at both ends show a life that is rooted and blooming at once.
meaning: The Four of Batons is fire that has found its hearth. Four in Marseille numerology is stability, the square, the solid ground on which things can rest. After the bursting energy of three, this card settles creative and vital power into a reliable structure: a home, a routine, a working method that holds. It is not static but steady, like a well-banked fire that warms all night. Build on what is working, enjoy the security you have earned, and let this foundation support your next creative leap.
numerology: Four is the number of stability and the square: the solid, reliable base where energy can be held, used and depended on.
affirmation: My fire is steady, and I build on solid ground.

ctx.past: A period of stability and security laid the groundwork for today. You built something solid, a home, a routine, a skill or a reliable way of working, and that steadiness is still holding you up. It may be so familiar now that you have forgotten how much effort it took to build.
ctx.present: Your energy has found a stable shape, like the four batons locked into a balanced square. Things are working, structures are holding and you have a reliable base underneath you. The heart of the matter is learning to enjoy and use this security, instead of bracing for it to collapse.
ctx.future: Stability is on its way. A project settles into a sustainable rhythm, a living situation becomes secure, or your energy finds a pace you can keep up for the long run. Expect a time when you can relax your shoulders a little and build steadily, brick by brick.
ctx.challenge: Stability can harden into rigidity. The obstacle may be clinging to what is comfortable, resisting every change, or letting your fire die down to embers out of fear of risk. Keep the hearth warm and well tended, but make sure you haven’t bolted the door against new life.
ctx.advice: Strengthen your foundations. Give your passion some structure: a schedule, a budget, a dedicated room or regular hours. Celebrate what you have already built, then treat that security as a platform to stand on and reach from, rather than a wall to hide behind.
ctx.self: You feel grounded, capable and secure in what you do, and people can count on you. You know it, too. Let that quiet confidence sit easily on you, without needing to prove yourself all over again every time someone new walks into the room.
ctx.others: Others see you as dependable and steady, a solid presence in their lives. Or your surroundings themselves offer a firm base, such as family, a loyal team or a community that welcomes you home. Lean on that support; it is part of what keeps your fire burning evenly.
ctx.hopes: You hope for security, a settled home or firm footing for your work. You may also fear that comfort will bore you, or that the ground could suddenly give way beneath you. This card answers that your foundation is sound and well built, and can carry real weight.
ctx.love: In love this is a steady, warm relationship with solid ground under it: commitment, setting up home together, or simply a bond that feels safe. Keep tending the flame with small gestures and shared plans, so that the comfort between you stays passionate as well as secure.
ctx.work: At work this favours steady employment, sound systems and projects that have found their footing. It is a good time to consolidate, organise and write down how things are done. Reliable, unglamorous effort now will hold up everything you build on top of it later.
ctx.spirit: Spirit invites you to give your practice a hearth of its own. A regular ritual, a small altar or a daily habit gives your inner fire a safe place to burn. Your guides honour the quiet power of consistency, and the way it deepens over months and years.
ctx.release: Let go of chaotic ways of working that scatter your energy and leave you drained. Release, too, the fear that stability means giving up adventure for good. A strong base is exactly what makes the next adventure possible, because you will have somewhere to return to.
ctx.shadow: Hidden beneath your need for security may be a fear of the unknown that you have not fully admitted. Ask whether the walls you have built are protecting your fire or slowly smothering it. Comfort can become a cage without anyone ever locking it from the outside.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation lies the need for a firm base. Everything here grows from a wish to feel safe, settled and in charge of your own energy. Once you see that, it becomes easier to tell which choices truly serve you and which only feel familiar.
ctx.gift: Your gift is reliability. You can build structures that last and hold other people steady as well. Hidden help comes from the solid ground you have already created, the routines, skills and relationships that keep supporting you even on days when your fire burns low.

name: Five of Batons
title: Cinq de Bâtons
imagery: Four batons cross in an X with a fifth rising straight through the centre, all bound by red rings and woven together in a blue braid. Red leaves with curling blue tips reach outward on each side, and two small yellow blossoms sprout at the heart of the crossing; there are no flowers at top or bottom. The upright central staff pierces the stable square of four, a new aim cutting through the old frame.
meaning: The Five of Batons is the moment when stability is no longer enough. In Marseille numerology five is a bridge, a new ideal or interest that leads beyond the secure square of four, and the central upright baton cuts straight through the settled pattern. This can feel like friction, competition or lively disagreement, but its purpose is growth. Something higher is calling your fire upward: a new vision, a creative ambition, a spiritual aim. Accept the challenge and let the tension sharpen you rather than scatter you.
numerology: Five is the bridge to a new ideal: it breaks the comfort of four by pointing toward something higher and asks you to cross over.
affirmation: I welcome the challenge that calls me higher.

ctx.past: A past challenge or a new interest pulled you beyond your comfort zone. Perhaps a rivalry, a restless itch or a sudden ideal broke an old pattern apart. That crossing, uncomfortable as it was, helped shape the person you are now and the situation you find yourself in.
ctx.present: Something is stirring the settled order, just as the fifth baton drives straight through the square of four. A new goal, a rival or a lively argument is pushing you out of comfort and into a more ambitious stance. The heart of the matter is choosing which ideal truly deserves your effort.
ctx.future: A test or new opportunity is coming that will stretch you. Expect lively competition, fresh ambitions or debates that sharpen your thinking. It may feel unsettling at first, but this is the bridge to the next level of your creativity, and you are able to cross it.
ctx.challenge: The shadow of five is friction for its own sake: arguing, competing or scattering energy across too many fights at once. Your block may simply be ego clashing with ego. Ask what higher aim makes the struggle worth it, and let the smaller battles go without a backward glance.
ctx.advice: Choose your new ideal and aim at it with your whole will. Use competition as a whetstone rather than a battlefield. Practise, test yourself against people who are better than you, and welcome honest feedback even when it stings, because it is showing you the way across the bridge.
ctx.self: You feel restless and ready to grow, and perhaps a little combative too. The old ways no longer satisfy you, and you are itching for something worth reaching for. Trust that urge; it is your fire looking for a worthier goal than the one it has outgrown.
ctx.others: Others may see you as challenging, ambitious or hard to pin down at the moment. Or your surroundings are competitive, full of strong personalities and clashing opinions. Treat those people as sparring partners who can make you better, rather than as enemies to be defeated.
ctx.hopes: You hope to find a purpose bigger than routine, something that makes the effort feel meaningful. You may also fear conflict, or failing the test once it arrives. The central staff on this card holds firm through the whole crossing: you can stand your ground and grow.
ctx.love: In love there may be spirited disagreement, or a shared need to grow beyond what has become too comfortable. Lively debate can bring you closer if both people stay respectful and curious. Ask yourselves what ideal you are reaching for together, and let that guide the friction.
ctx.work: At work, expect competition, new challenges or a push toward a more ambitious target. Brainstorms and heated discussions can produce brilliant ideas right now. Keep your attention on the vision itself, though, not on winning every argument or proving someone else wrong.
ctx.spirit: Spirit is calling you toward a higher aim. Your guides may even be stirring up dissatisfaction on purpose, so that you go looking for something more meaningful than comfort. Ask in prayer or meditation what your fire is truly for, and listen for the answer.
ctx.release: Let go of petty rivalries and the need to be right in every exchange. Release the kind of comfort that has quietly turned into stagnation. The bridge in front of you only works if you are willing to step off the familiar ground on this side.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be a fear that you are not good enough to reach your ideal, masked by bickering or busyness. Or you may enjoy conflict more than you care to admit. Look honestly at what is really fuelling the friction, and whether it serves your growth.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation lies a new aspiration that disrupted the old order. Something higher started calling, and the tension you feel comes from answering that call while your old life still pulls the other way. That pull and counter-pull is the engine of growth.
ctx.gift: Your gift is the courage to grow through challenge. You can turn friction into strength and rivalry into real skill. Hidden help often comes from the very people who push and test you, so thank your sharpest critics; they are helping you sharpen your aim.

name: Six of Batons
title: Six de Bâtons
imagery: Two bundles of three batons cross in a broad X, their middles tightly braided in blue and bound with red rings. A red blossom on a yellow cup crowns the card and another blooms at the base, each held by sweeping blue leaves, while small yellow flowers and red flame-shaped leaves fill the sides. The woven centre and the full blossoms show desire and pleasure meeting in a lovely, balanced pattern.
meaning: The Six of Batons is the pleasure of doing what you love. In the Marseille count, six is beauty, delight and the first taste of real satisfaction, and here the suit of fire turns that into passionate, creative joy. The tightly braided centre shows energy that flows easily because it comes from the heart. This card favours art, sensuality, enthusiasm and work that feels like play. Let yourself enjoy your talents and your desires without guilt; this joy is not a distraction from your path, it is the path.
numerology: Six is the number of pleasure, beauty and first fulfilment: doing what you love and finding that it nourishes you.
affirmation: I follow my joy, and my creativity flows freely.

ctx.past: You once found real joy in something, and that delight shaped where you are now. A passion, a piece of creative work or a pleasurable chapter of life left its mark on you. It reminds you what it feels like when your energy flows freely and the work loves you back.
ctx.present: Right now your fire is flowing toward pleasure and beauty, braided together like the tight blue weave at the centre of this card. You are doing, or longing to do, what you love. The heart of the matter is allowing that delight to guide your choices instead of apologising for it.
ctx.future: A joyful phase is coming, with blossoms opening at both ends of the stem. Expect creative satisfaction, passionate experiences or appreciation for the things you love to do. Make room in your calendar and your heart for pleasure, because it is arriving whether you plan for it or not.
ctx.challenge: Pleasure can tip into self-indulgence or vanity. The obstacle may be chasing only what feels good in the moment, or caring more about the beautiful surface than about depth and craft. Enjoy yourself fully, but stay honest about whether this delight is feeding you or merely distracting you.
ctx.advice: Do the thing that lights you up. Choose projects, people and pastimes that bring genuine joy, and invest your best energy there. Treat pleasure as useful information about your path rather than a guilty extra, and notice how much better your work becomes when you love it.
ctx.self: You feel attractive, inspired and in tune with your passions, and creativity comes easily to you right now. There is a natural grace in how you move through your days. Let yourself be seen enjoying your life; your pleasure gives others permission to enjoy theirs.
ctx.others: Others see you as radiant and passionate, a person who clearly loves what they do. Or someone around you has a creativity and warmth that is rubbing off on you. Spend time near their fire, because their joy can rekindle parts of yours that had gone quiet.
ctx.hopes: You hope to fill your life with what you truly love. You may also fear that pleasure is frivolous, or that it can’t possibly last. This card insists that joy is meaningful, a sign of energy flowing where it belongs, and well worth protecting from cynics and guilt alike.
ctx.love: In love this is passion, sensuality and delight: a relationship full of play, attraction and shared beauty. Enjoy each other’s company and express desire freely and warmly. Romance here feels creative, as though the two of you are making something lovely together just by being close.
ctx.work: At work it points to work you love, creative success or a project that energises rather than drains you. Lean into your natural talents and the tasks you would happily do for free. When you enjoy your craft, the quality shows, and people notice and come back for more.
ctx.spirit: Spirit speaks to you through joy. Your guides remind you that the sacred can be found in art, dance, music, good food and the pleasures of the body. Celebrate your aliveness as a spiritual act, and let gratitude for beauty become a form of prayer.
ctx.release: Let go of guilt about enjoying yourself, and of the habit of postponing pleasure to some imagined future when everything is finally done. Release work or routines that bring no satisfaction at all, if you can. Life is asking you to bloom now, not someday.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be an over-attachment to how things look, or a fear that without constant excitement life would feel empty. Ask whether you are seeking deep joy or quick distraction. True pleasure leaves you nourished, while its imitation leaves you hungry and restless.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation lies a desire for beauty and pleasure. Everything here grows from a passion, the wish to create something lovely or to live more vividly. Honour that root, because it is healthy, and let it shape your choices more openly.
ctx.gift: Your gift is creative joy. You can make life more beautiful, both for yourself and for those around you, almost without trying. Hidden help comes through your talents and through whatever makes your heart beat faster, so follow that pulse and see where it leads you.

name: Seven of Batons
title: Sept de Bâtons
imagery: Six batons cross in an X, three by three, braided in blue and bound in red, while a single slender staff runs straight up the centre from bottom to top. Red flame-like leaves spread on each side, and small yellow-green sprouts burst from the crossing. The upright central baton drives through the woven mass, a single will acting powerfully through everything around it.
meaning: The Seven of Batons is fire in action, moving out into the world with confidence. In Marseille numerology seven is the most active odd number, the force that acts on the world, and the central upright baton here pierces through the whole crossing. This is the card of courage, assertion and effective effort. You are no longer only dreaming; you are doing, defending your position and making an impact. Stand by your convictions, use your energy decisively, and trust that you have what it takes.
numerology: Seven is the number of action in the world: dynamic, effective energy that moves outward and changes things.
affirmation: I act with courage, and my will moves the world.

ctx.past: A bold action in the past shaped this situation. You stood up for something, took the lead or pushed through obstacles that others avoided. The effects of that act of will are still unfolding now, and you can draw courage from remembering how well you handled it.
ctx.present: You are in action mode, like the single staff driving straight up through the whole crossing on this card. Your energy is strong, outward-moving and effective. The heart of the matter is standing firm in your purpose while the world around you reacts, pushes back and adjusts.
ctx.future: A time of vigorous action is coming. You will be called to lead, defend your ideas or carry a project forward through resistance. Expect challenges along the way, but also the stamina and conviction to meet them, and a real sense of accomplishment once you are through.
ctx.challenge: The shadow of seven is force without wisdom: aggression, pushing too hard, or defending positions that no longer matter. You may be fighting battles that drain more than they give back. Choose carefully where to aim your power, and let unimportant struggles fall away.
ctx.advice: Act decisively. Take a stand, say what you mean, and move forward with confidence instead of waiting for permission. Your initiative is what will open the way. Pick one clear goal and drive toward it, the way the central baton runs straight from bottom to top.
ctx.self: You feel strong, capable and determined, and you know what you want. You are ready to go after it without much hesitation. Trust that strength and use it wisely, remembering that real power includes the ability to pause, listen and change course when needed.
ctx.others: Others see you as forceful and effective, perhaps even a little intimidating. Some may resist you, while others will happily follow your lead. Or someone around you is taking strong action that affects your plans, and you will need to decide whether to join them or hold your ground.
ctx.hopes: You hope to make a real impact and to be taken seriously. You may also fear opposition, or being seen as too much. The single upright staff on this card says your conviction can carry you through, as long as it stays rooted in something you truly believe.
ctx.love: In love this calls for courage: saying how you feel, defending the relationship when it matters, or making a bold move toward someone. Passion runs strong. Make sure your assertiveness includes listening as well as acting, so that your partner feels met rather than steamrolled.
ctx.work: At work this favours leadership, initiative and decisive projects. You can push things through now that once seemed stuck. Stand by your ideas in meetings, take responsibility for results, and use your drive to deliver concrete outcomes rather than just impressive plans.
ctx.spirit: Spirit honours your will in action. Your guides support you in living your values openly and courageously, out in the world rather than only in private. Let your spiritual life be expressed through deeds: what you defend, what you build and how you treat people.
ctx.release: Let go of hesitation and the habit of waiting for the perfect moment that never quite arrives. Release fights that aren’t yours to fight, too, so that your energy flows where it truly matters. A clear will is lighter to carry than a dozen half-hearted ones.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be a need to prove yourself, or old anger quietly fuelling your drive. Ask whether you are acting from purpose or from a wish to win at any cost. Power used to settle old scores tends to burn the hand that holds it.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation lies a strong will determined to act. It exists because someone chose to step forward and push, rather than wait. Recognising whose will that was, and what it wanted, helps you decide whether to keep pushing or to change direction.
ctx.gift: Your gift is effective courage. You can turn intention into results and inspire others simply by going first. Hidden help comes from your own determination, which tends to attract allies once they see you are serious and willing to stand in the open.

name: Eight of Batons
title: Huit de Bâtons
imagery: Two broad bundles of four batons cross in a great X, their centre forming a large blue diamond of tight lattice work outlined in red. A small flower with blue leaves sits at the top and another at the bottom, but the sides are bare, with no leaves or blossoms. The vast woven diamond is fire made perfect and ordered, its energy fully gathered and contained.
meaning: The Eight of Batons is fire at its fullest and most perfected. In Marseille numerology eight is completeness and perfection in matter, the double square, and here the wide lattice diamond shows creative and vital energy brought into flawless order. Nothing is lacking, nothing is wasted. This is the card of mastery in your passion, intense focus and a great reservoir of power ready to be used. Recognise how much strength you hold, and let it work for you with precision and grace.
numerology: Eight is perfection and fullness, the doubled square where energy reaches its most complete and ordered form.
affirmation: My energy is whole, focused and powerful.

ctx.past: A time of deep concentration or mastery laid the groundwork for today. You once poured yourself completely into something and reached a high level of skill. That fullness, the experience of giving everything and having it come together, still feeds and supports this situation.
ctx.present: Your energy is at its peak and beautifully ordered, like the great woven diamond at the heart of this card. You have all the fire you need, gathered and focused in one place. The heart of the matter is using this full power with care, precision and clear intention.
ctx.future: A period of intensity and accomplishment is approaching. Expect your creative or vital energy to reach a high point, and things you have worked on to settle into their finished, perfected form. You will be able to see clearly what all the effort was for.
ctx.challenge: Perfection can become a pressure cooker. The obstacle may be perfectionism, over-control, or so much stored energy that it feels overwhelming and has nowhere to go. Even a perfect fire needs air to breathe, so leave a little space for spontaneity and rest.
ctx.advice: Concentrate. Put your full energy into one thing and do it with excellence, the way every strand in this card’s lattice is placed with care. Organise your resources, refine your technique, and trust the mastery you have already built through practice and patience.
ctx.self: You feel full of power and in command of your craft. You know your strength and what you are capable of when you focus. Let yourself own that mastery calmly, without apologising for it and without needing everyone else to confirm it first.
ctx.others: Others see you as intense and accomplished, perhaps a little intimidating in your focus. Or someone around you embodies mastery and total commitment, a model you can learn a great deal from. Watch how they organise their energy and borrow what suits you.
ctx.hopes: You hope to reach your fullest potential and feel whole in what you do. You may also fear that such a level is impossible to sustain. The ordered diamond on this card says you can hold this power, as long as you keep your focus clear and your aims simple.
ctx.love: In love this is intense, complete passion: a bond that feels whole and fully alive, with desire well matched on both sides. Everything seems to fit. Make sure the intensity leaves room for gentleness and ordinary days, so the relationship can breathe as well as burn.
ctx.work: At work this shows peak performance, real mastery and excellent results. Great productivity is possible now, and quality is high. Pour this concentrated energy into your most important project rather than spreading it thin, and the outcome can be something you are proud of for years.
ctx.spirit: Spirit reflects your fullness back to you. Your guides remind you that you are already whole, a vessel of living fire rather than a broken thing in need of fixing. Rest in that completeness during meditation, and let it shape how you treat yourself.
ctx.release: Let go of the belief that you are always lacking something. Release scattered efforts and side projects that pull you away from your centre, and gather your energy where it matters most. Fullness comes from focus, not from doing everything at once.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be a fear of your own power, or perfectionism quietly covering insecurity. Ask whether your intensity serves your work or keeps other people at a careful distance. Sometimes the tightest weave hides the softest heart, and it needs air too.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation lies concentrated energy and a drive for completeness. Everything here grows from a fullness of passion and commitment, from someone giving their all. Understanding that intensity explains both the brilliant results and the strain they may bring.
ctx.gift: Your gift is mastery and focused power. When you concentrate, you can accomplish remarkable things that others think impossible. Hidden help comes through your own refined skill, built patiently over time, and through the trust that people place in work done this thoroughly.

name: Nine of Batons
title: Neuf de Bâtons
imagery: Eight batons cross in a wide X around a blue lattice diamond outlined in red, and a single thin upright staff passes straight through the centre from top to bottom. There are no flowers and no leaves anywhere on the card. The bare, flowerless pattern shows a moment past blooming, while the lone central staff is the thread of will that carries you through the passage.
meaning: The Nine of Batons is fire at a crossroads. In the Marseille count, nine is crisis and transition: the perfection of eight must break open so a new cycle can begin. Without flowers or leaves, this card shows a time when the old pleasures and supports fall away and you go on with only your inner strength, symbolised by the single upright staff. It can feel like endurance, solitude or a test of resolve. But nine is a passage, not an ending. Let go of what is complete, hold your inner thread, and keep walking toward what comes next.
numerology: Nine is the number of crisis and transition, where a completed cycle opens up and you let go in order to move into something new.
affirmation: I hold my inner fire through every passage.

ctx.past: A crisis or turning point in the past shaped this situation. Something ended or fell away, and you carried on with only your inner strength to lean on. That stretch of endurance is part of who you are now, and it proved you can walk through difficult passages.
