ctx.present: You are in a passage. The flowers and leaves have dropped from this card, and you are walking forward on inner resolve alone, like the thin upright staff threading through its centre. The heart of the matter is trusting that this crisis is the doorway into a new cycle.
ctx.future: A transition is coming. Something will reach its natural end so that a fresh beginning can arise in its place. Expect a time of letting go and steady endurance, followed by renewal once the old form has fully cleared away. The emptiness is temporary.
ctx.challenge: The shadow of nine is exhaustion or stubbornness: clinging to the old form because you are afraid of the gap between endings and beginnings. Or you may be pushing on alone when help is close at hand. Learn to tell the difference between perseverance and simply refusing to let go.
ctx.advice: Let go of what is finished and hold steady to your core. Take one step at a time, without demanding to see the whole road ahead. This is a moment for patience, faith in yourself and trust that the change underway is carrying you somewhere you need to go.
ctx.self: You feel tested and perhaps weary, but you haven’t lost your fire. You know how to endure, and you have done it before. Honour your resilience, and give yourself permission to rest along the way instead of treating tiredness as a personal failure.
ctx.others: Others may see you as solitary or guarded during this period, as you turn inward to get through it. Or the people and places around you are themselves in transition. Some relationships may fall away now, and others will prove surprisingly steady companions on the road.
ctx.hopes: You hope to come through this time stronger and lighter than before. You may also fear that the crisis will never end. The upright staff passing through the whole card says your inner strength runs from the beginning of this passage to its end.
ctx.love: In love this shows a transition: a relationship passing through a test, a need for space, or letting go of an old pattern so something truer can grow. Be gentle with yourself and with others, and resist making permanent decisions in the middle of the storm.
ctx.work: At work a phase is ending and something new is quietly preparing. You may be finishing a project, leaving a role or rethinking your path altogether. Persist where it truly matters, and allow what no longer fits to drop away without dragging it along for appearances.
ctx.spirit: Spirit is walking with you across the threshold. Your guides remind you that every crisis holds the seed of rebirth, even when nothing seems to be growing. Trust the passage, even in the dark, and keep lighting a small candle of practice each day.
ctx.release: Let go of comforts and structures that have served their purpose and now only weigh you down. Release your grip on how things used to be, and on the version of you that belonged there. Your hands need to be free to pick up what comes next.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be a fear of change disguised as loyalty, or exhaustion you haven’t admitted even to yourself. Ask what you are holding on to, and why. Sometimes we stay with what is finished simply because the unknown feels lonelier than the familiar ache.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation lies the end of a cycle. A completion has arrived, and now it demands a transition you cannot skip. Seeing that clearly helps you stop fighting the passage and start moving through it with more grace and less struggle.
ctx.gift: Your gift is resilience. You can walk through crisis without losing your fire, and you come out wiser on the other side. Hidden help comes through your own steady will, that thin and unbroken line of intention running through the centre of everything.

name: Ten of Batons
title: Dix de Bâtons
imagery: Eight batons cross in a great X around a blue lattice diamond bordered in red, while two short upright batons stand side by side at top and bottom, each banded in red. Red leaves with blue tips appear at the sides, but there are no flowers. The doubled upright pieces cut the crossing like a seal of completion, and the cycle of fire stands finished and ready to pass into a new form.
meaning: The Ten of Batons closes the cycle of fire. In Marseille numerology ten is the end of a series and the passage into a new one, and here the doubled upright staffs seal the great crossing like a full stop. Creative energy, passion and drive have done their work. This card asks you to recognise what you have accomplished and to let it transform: a project complete, a phase of ambition fulfilled, a fire that has burned its fuel. What comes next may belong to a different suit of life, perhaps feeling, thought or practical matters. Honour the ending and welcome the change.
numerology: Ten is completion and the turning of the cycle: the series is finished, and its energy prepares to pass into a new beginning.
affirmation: I honour what I have completed and welcome what comes next.

ctx.past: A cycle reached its end in the past, and this situation grew out of that completion. A project, an ambition or a passion ran its full course, and you are now living among what it left behind. Its lessons are still with you, even if its fire has gone out.
ctx.present: A chapter of your creative or passionate life is closing, sealed like the paired upright staffs that cut through this card’s crossing. You have done the work, and now it is time to recognise the result. The heart of the matter is letting this cycle end with grace rather than a struggle.
ctx.future: An ending and a new beginning are approaching hand in hand. Expect a project to wrap up, a phase to close and fresh energy to appear in a different form, perhaps in a completely different area of life. Prepare to hand on what is complete and turn toward what is waiting.
ctx.challenge: The shadow of ten is holding on too long and refusing to let a finished thing finish. Or you may be carrying a load that is no longer yours to bear. Recognise that the series has reached its last number, and allow the cycle to turn instead of starting the same round again.
ctx.advice: Close the chapter consciously. Finish what needs finishing, thank the people who helped, and celebrate what you achieved, even quietly. Then let go, and turn toward a new kind of energy rather than trying to squeeze one more round out of a fire that has done its work.
ctx.self: You feel mature and accomplished, perhaps tired, and ready for something different. You have given this your all and seen it through. Respect that, and allow yourself to change direction without feeling disloyal to the person who started the journey.
ctx.others: Others see you as experienced and accomplished, someone who has been through the whole cycle. Or you may be handing your role, project or passion on to someone else now. Either way the environment around you is shifting into a new phase with new faces.
ctx.hopes: You hope to complete this cycle well and discover what comes next. You may also fear the emptiness that follows a big ending. This card says completion is never just loss; it clears a space where new life can begin, often in a direction you didn’t expect.
ctx.love: In love this is the completion of a phase: a relationship maturing into a new stage, or the close of a passionate chapter so that something deeper can grow. Honour what you have shared together, and be open to the different, quieter kind of warmth that may come next.
ctx.work: At work a project or a stage of your career is completing. It is time to wrap up loose ends, document what you know, hand over cleanly and consider your next move. Your experience is your harvest, so gather it up and carry it forward into whatever comes next.
ctx.spirit: Spirit honours endings as sacred. Your guides remind you that every completion is also a birth, and that the fire of one cycle becomes the seed of the next. Mark this moment with a small ritual of thanks, and trust that nothing you have lived is wasted.
ctx.release: Let go of the finished project, the old ambition and the identity that was tied to this completed cycle. Release them with gratitude rather than regret. Your hands, your calendar and your heart need to be emptied a little before they can hold something new.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be a fear of who you will be once this is over. Ask whether you are clinging to the familiar simply because the unknown frightens you. Sometimes we keep a finished fire going out of habit, long after it has stopped giving us any warmth.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation lies a completed cycle. Everything here grows from the fulfilment and ending of a long effort, the last number in a series. Once you see that clearly, it becomes easier to stop forcing and start preparing for the next beginning.
ctx.gift: Your gift is maturity. You know how to see things through and how to begin again with wisdom instead of naivety. Hidden help comes through the experience you have gathered, which you can now share, teach or carry into an entirely new kind of work.

name: Valet of Batons
title: Valet de Bâtons
imagery: A young man in a red cap with a yellow band stands in profile, gazing to the right, dressed in a blue tunic under a red cloak lined in yellow. Both his hands rest on a tall green baton planted in the yellow earth, with a tuft of grass at his feet. He leans on his staff and studies the distance, as if weighing what to do with the power he has just found.
meaning: The Valet of Batons is the first, uncertain encounter with your own fire. In Marseille courts the Valet is the apprentice, full of potential but not yet sure how to use it, and this young man leans on his raw green staff while looking ahead. He has power in his hands and is wondering where to direct it. This card speaks of a new passion, a creative or sexual awakening, or a project you are just beginning to explore. Let yourself be curious and eager, but don’t rush; the staff is already rooted in the ground, and you have time to learn.
numerology: The Valet is the first step of the court: a learner meeting the suit’s energy for the first time, still hesitating between doing and waiting.
affirmation: I explore my passion with curiosity and courage.

ctx.past: An early discovery of your passion or talent shaped this situation. You picked up a new interest, or felt a spark of creativity for the first time, and leaned on it like the Valet leans on his green staff. That beginning, however tentative, still matters a great deal.
ctx.present: You are just getting to know your own fire. A new passion, talent or desire has arrived, and like this young man gazing into the distance, you are working out what to do with it. The heart of the matter is learning without fear of getting it wrong at first.
ctx.future: A fresh interest or opportunity is coming your way. Expect news, an invitation or a spark of inspiration that wakes up your enthusiasm. Approach it with an eager beginner’s mind, ready to ask questions, and let it teach you what you are capable of.
ctx.challenge: The Valet’s shadow is hesitation, or the opposite, immature impatience. You may stand leaning on your staff, staring ahead without moving, or rush in with no experience at all. Find the balance between study and action, and let small steps build your confidence.
ctx.advice: Explore. Try something new, sign up for a class, or start a small creative project with no pressure to be good at it yet. Ask questions and let yourself be a beginner. Lift your staff from where it rests and take the first step toward the horizon you keep looking at.
ctx.self: You see yourself as eager but inexperienced, full of energy you don’t quite know how to direct. That is a lovely place to be, even if it feels awkward. Your curiosity is your strength, and the raw green wood of your staff is still alive and growing.
ctx.others: Others see you as youthful and enthusiastic, perhaps a little unsure of yourself. Or a young or new person in your life brings fresh energy, curiosity and a passion that is still finding its shape. Encourage them, and you may rediscover your own early spark.
ctx.hopes: You hope to discover what truly fires you up. You may also fear that you aren’t ready, skilled or bold enough yet. The staff planted firmly in the earth says you already hold the potential; it simply needs time, practice and a little nerve to come into its own.
ctx.love: In love this is a new attraction or the early, slightly shy stage of flirtation, full of promise. Be playful and honest, and don’t worry about looking polished. Let desire unfold at its own pace, without pressure to define it before both of you have had time to explore.
ctx.work: At work a new opportunity, apprenticeship or project appears. You are learning a fresh skill or entering an unfamiliar field. Show your enthusiasm, be willing to learn from more experienced people, and don’t be afraid to ask the questions that everyone else is too proud to ask.
ctx.spirit: Spirit is awakening a new passion in you. Your guides invite you to explore spiritual practices with the curiosity of a student stepping into a new world. Try a different ritual, read something unfamiliar, or simply notice what makes your inner fire flicker brighter.
ctx.release: Let go of the fear of looking inexperienced or foolish. Release the need to have everything figured out before you start, and the habit of comparing your first attempts with other people’s finished work. Every master once stood exactly where you stand now.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be doubt about your own power, or eagerness that quietly covers insecurity. Ask what is really holding you back from lifting your staff and walking. Often it is not lack of ability but fear of being seen while you are still learning.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation lies a young, untested passion. Everything here grows from a new desire that is only beginning to find its form. Treat it like a sapling: protect it, give it light and resist the urge to judge it before it has grown.
ctx.gift: Your gift is fresh enthusiasm and the openness of a beginner. You see possibilities that experienced people overlook. Hidden help comes through your curiosity, your willingness to learn and the mentors who are drawn to someone so genuinely eager to grow.

name: Knight of Batons
title: Cavalier de Bâtons
imagery: A rider in a wide-brimmed blue and yellow hat with a red band holds a yellow baton raised upright in his right hand, sitting tall on a white horse with a blue mane. The horse turns its head down and to the left, draped in a pale caparison, while the rider looks out with calm assurance over lumpy yellow and green ground. The raised baton is passion carried proudly into the world, and the horse is the vital energy that bears it forward.
meaning: The Cavalier de Bâtons is fire on the move. In the Marseille courts, the Knight carries the suit’s energy out into the world, and this rider holds his baton high as he advances. He is passionate, adventurous and confident, bringing his mission wherever he goes. This card speaks of bold ventures, journeys, spreading your ideas and acting on your desires. Ride your enthusiasm boldly, but stay in tune with your horse: the body and instincts that carry you.
numerology: The Knight is the court figure in motion, carrying the suit’s mastery outward into the world on a mission.
affirmation: I carry my passion boldly into the world.

ctx.past: A bold move or adventure in the past shaped this situation. You carried your passion out into the world, perhaps by travelling, changing course or spreading your ideas far and wide. That journey still echoes in where you stand now and in the confidence you carry.
ctx.present: You are on the move, full of energy and confidence, holding your baton high like this rider on his white horse. Your passion is leading you forward. The heart of the matter is riding that energy with a clear purpose rather than galloping off in every direction at once.
ctx.future: Action and adventure are on the way. Expect travel, a new venture or a bold initiative that sweeps you forward faster than you planned. Saddle up and pack lightly, because things are about to move quickly, and you will want to be ready to go when they do.
ctx.challenge: The Cavalier’s shadow is impulsiveness: rushing ahead, changing direction constantly or leaving things half finished behind you. Your fire may be outrunning your plans. Keep your mission clear and listen to your horse, the body and instincts that tell you when to slow down.
ctx.advice: Take bold action. Pursue your goals with passion, travel if you can, and share your vision with anyone who will listen. Move forward with your baton raised, and let your enthusiasm open doors. Just choose a destination before you set off, so your energy has somewhere to land.
ctx.self: You feel confident, energetic and ready for adventure, eager to take on the world and see what it holds. Trust that passion and let it carry you forward. At the same time, notice when you need to rest the horse; even the boldest riders stop to water and recover.
ctx.others: Others see you as dynamic, adventurous and inspiring, though perhaps a little restless and hard to keep up with. Or someone bold and passionate is riding into your life, bringing excitement and momentum. Their arrival can shake things loose that had been stuck for far too long.
ctx.hopes: You hope for adventure and a mission that truly matters to you. You may also fear burning out, or never being able to settle down anywhere. The steady white horse on this card says you can ride a long way if you respect your energy and pace the journey.
ctx.love: In love this brings passionate pursuit, a bold romance or a relationship full of adventure and spontaneity. Desire runs high and things may move fast. If you want the fire to last, pair the chase with real commitment, and make sure you are riding toward someone, not away from something.
ctx.work: At work this favours bold initiatives, business travel and spreading your ideas through promotion and networking. You are a persuasive ambassador right now. Pace yourself, though, and keep track of the details, so that your energy lasts the whole journey and your projects actually arrive.
ctx.spirit: Spirit invites you on a quest. Your guides encourage you to carry your faith out into the world and let your actions express your spiritual fire. A pilgrimage, a meaningful trip or a cause you champion can become a living prayer for you now.
ctx.release: Let go of stagnation and the fear of moving forward. Release projects and situations that keep you tied to the stable when your heart is longing to ride out. Sometimes the bravest thing is simply to open the gate and go.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be a restlessness that covers a fear of commitment, or a need to keep moving so that you don’t have to feel what is underneath. Ask yourself honestly what you might be riding away from, and whether it would be lighter to turn and face it.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation lies passionate movement. Everything here grows from someone’s bold decision to go out into the world and act on their desire. Knowing where that energy was headed, and why, helps you decide whether to keep riding or change course.
ctx.gift: Your gift is fearless enthusiasm. You can carry ideas and energy into new places and inspire people along the way. Hidden help comes through your courage to set out, which tends to attract allies, opportunities and lucky meetings on the road.

name: Queen of Batons
title: Reine de Bâtons
imagery: A crowned queen with long dark flowing hair sits in a red gown and a sweeping blue mantle, holding a large yellow club that rests against her shoulder. Her other hand lies across her lap and belly, and she looks out calmly with a steady gaze. The heavy club shows that she holds great vital power with ease, and her hand on her lap speaks of the creative fire she keeps close and nourishes from within.
meaning: The Reine de Bâtons is fire held in mastery and warmth. She rests her great club on her shoulder without strain, showing that her power is natural, not forced. In the Marseille tradition she is the queen of creative and vital energy turned inward: she knows her desires, her sexuality and her strength, and she cultivates them with confidence. This card speaks of radiant self-possession, warm leadership, creativity and independence. Claim your power as she does, calmly and fully, and let it nourish both you and those around you.
numerology: The Queen is the receptive mastery of the suit, holding and nurturing its energy from within with calm authority.
affirmation: I hold my power with ease and let it radiate.

ctx.past: A period of confident self-possession shaped this situation. You claimed your power, your creativity or your desire, and held it as easily as this queen rests her heavy club on her shoulder. That strength laid the groundwork for where you are now.
ctx.present: You are in full command of your fire. Your creativity and confidence are strong, and you carry your power without strain. The heart of the matter is owning that strength openly, without apologising for it or shrinking it to make others more comfortable.
ctx.future: A time of radiant confidence is coming. Expect to step into a leadership role, express your creativity fully, or meet a warm and powerful woman who supports your path. Your sense of your own worth will grow steadier and more natural with each passing week.
ctx.challenge: The Reine’s shadow is possessiveness or a need to control: holding your club too tightly, or using charm and warmth to dominate rather than to nurture. Make sure your power feeds the people around you instead of crowding them or demanding their constant attention.
ctx.advice: Claim your power calmly. Trust your desires and your talents, take the lead, and express yourself with confidence. Care for your body and your creative energy as precious resources, the way the queen keeps one hand resting protectively on her lap.
ctx.self: You feel strong, warm and self-assured, comfortable in your skin and clear about your desires. You know what you want and how to go after it. Let your confidence shine without needing outside approval, and enjoy the steadiness that comes from trusting yourself.
ctx.others: Others see you as radiant, powerful and magnetic, someone people naturally gather around. Or a confident, creative woman in your life offers support and inspiration. Her warmth and certainty can help you claim your own power more fully and more gracefully.
ctx.hopes: You hope to feel fully confident and creatively alive. You may also fear being too much, or being judged for your strength and desire. The queen sits calmly with her club at rest, showing that real power is natural and beautiful, not something to hide.
ctx.love: In love this brings warmth, passion and confidence. You know your worth and what you desire, and you can ask for it plainly. Relationships thrive now when you show both your strength and your tenderness, letting your partner see the whole of your fire.
ctx.work: At work this favours leadership, creative projects and independent ventures. You have the confidence and skill to guide others and to run things your own way. Lead with warmth and conviction, and you will find people willing to follow your vision.
ctx.spirit: Spirit honours your inner fire. Your guides remind you that your vitality, sensuality and creativity are sacred, not distractions from the spiritual path. Tend that flame as a daily practice, whether through art, movement, devotion or simply caring for your body.
ctx.release: Let go of self-doubt and the old habit of making yourself smaller. Release relationships or roles where you cannot express your power or your creativity. You are allowed to take up the space that your fire naturally fills.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be jealousy, or a fear of losing control if you relax your grip. Ask whether you hold your club to create or to defend. Power held from fear feels heavy, while power held from confidence rests lightly, as it does on this queen’s shoulder.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation lies confident creative power. Everything here grows from someone’s strong sense of self and clear desire. Recognising that root helps you see where to lead from your warmth and where to soften your hold a little.
ctx.gift: Your gift is radiant self-possession. You inspire others simply by being fully and unapologetically yourself. Hidden help comes through your warmth, your confidence and your creative fire, which draw allies and opportunities toward you naturally.

name: King of Batons
title: Roi de Bâtons
imagery: A king in a broad blue and red hat topped with a golden crown sits on a yellow throne, armoured in blue with a yellow belt and red shoulder plates. With his right hand he holds a long tapering baton, striped and pointed, upright with its tip toward the ground; his left hand rests on his hip. His steady gaze and planted feet show the calm of a man who has fully mastered his fire and now directs it with precision.
meaning: The Roi de Bâtons is mastery of the fire in action. In the Marseille courts the King has completed his journey with the suit, and here his slender, refined baton shows energy honed to a point. He sits calmly, confident in his authority, his hand on his hip in a gesture of ease and command. This card speaks of visionary leadership, creative power used responsibly and the wisdom of long experience. Lead with integrity, trust your vision, and use your power to build what will last.
numerology: The King is the culmination of the court, the full and active mastery of the suit expressed with authority in the world.
affirmation: I lead with vision and use my power wisely.

ctx.past: A period of leadership or mastery shaped this situation. You, or a strong figure in your life, took charge, guided others and made decisions that lasted. That authority still shapes things today, and its example can teach you a great deal about how to hold power.
ctx.present: You hold real authority over your creative and vital energy. Like this king with his finely pointed baton, you know how to direct your fire precisely where it is needed. The heart of the matter is leading with vision, fairness and integrity.
ctx.future: A time of leadership and achievement is coming. Expect to take charge, see your vision become real, or meet a powerful, experienced man who offers guidance or opportunity. The groundwork you have laid is ready to carry real weight and real responsibility.
ctx.challenge: The Roi’s shadow is domination or arrogance: using power to control rather than to inspire. Your experience may also make you rigid, sure you already know every answer. Lead with openness, stay humble, and remember that authority is something others grant you.
ctx.advice: Take the lead. Trust your experience, define your vision clearly and guide others toward it. Use your power precisely and responsibly, the way the king points his slender baton toward the ground, putting your energy exactly where it will do the most good.
ctx.self: You feel confident, capable and in command, seated firmly in your own authority. You know your strengths and you are not easily rattled. Use that steadiness to inspire and empower others, rather than simply to keep everything under your own control.
ctx.others: Others see you as a natural leader, visionary and authoritative, someone whose word carries weight. Or a powerful, experienced man in your life offers guidance, protection or an opening. Listen to his counsel, and notice how calmly he holds his power.
ctx.hopes: You hope to lead well and see your vision realised. You may also fear the responsibility, or letting down those who depend on you. The king sits at ease, hand on hip, showing that you are more ready for this role than your nerves suggest.
ctx.love: In love this brings a mature, passionate and committed partner, or the call for you to become one. Lead your relationship with honesty, generosity and steady warmth. Shared plans and a strong sense of direction can help passion grow into something lasting.
ctx.work: At work this favours leadership, entrepreneurship and visionary projects. You have the experience to direct others and make bold strategic calls. Be decisive, fair and clear, and use your influence to build something that outlasts your own involvement.
ctx.spirit: Spirit honours your mastery. Your guides remind you that true power serves something greater than the self. Let your leadership become an act of devotion, and ask regularly whom your fire is warming and whether it is lighting the way for others too.
ctx.release: Let go of the need to control every detail. Release outdated ideas of power as domination, and trust others to carry their share. A wise king knows when to delegate, when to listen and when to simply sit back and let others shine.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be pride, or a fear of losing your authority if you show any weakness. Ask whether your leadership comes from genuine vision or from ego. The most respected rulers are often the ones who admit what they don’t know.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation lies mature, directed power. Everything here grows from someone’s experience, authority and long-held vision. Understanding whose vision it is, and what it truly serves, will show you how best to support it or to challenge it.
ctx.gift: Your gift is visionary leadership. You can turn passion into lasting achievement and lift others along with you. Hidden help comes through your experience and the respect you have earned, which open doors that enthusiasm alone could never reach.

name: Ace of Cups
title: As de Coupes
imagery: A single great golden cup fills the card, its lid built like a cathedral or walled city, with turrets tipped in red and red jewels set into its facade. Blue leaves burst out from under the lid around a deep red bowl, and the stem, knotted in red, rests on a broad golden foot planted on striped earth. It is the heart as a temple: love housed and raised up like a holy place, yet rooted in the ground of real life.
meaning: The Ace of Cups is the whole potential of the heart gathered in one vessel, love before it has chosen a name or a direction. In the Marseille deck this is no simple chalice but a building, a sanctuary with towers, as if the soul were a cathedral you carry inside you. It speaks of new feeling, a deep capacity to give and receive love, and the first stirring of devotion, friendship, faith or creative inspiration. The blue leaves springing from under the lid show that this treasure is alive and already overflowing its walls. When it appears, open the doors of your inner temple: something tender and sacred is ready to be received and shared.
numerology: One is pure potential, the seed that holds everything to come. In Cups it is the heart's entire capacity for love, still gathered in a single source.
affirmation: My heart is a temple, and its doors are open.

ctx.past: Your story here began with a great opening of the heart: a love, a friendship, a spiritual awakening or a moment of being deeply moved. That first overflowing feeling built something like a sanctuary inside you, and it still quietly shapes how you meet this situation.
ctx.present: Right now your heart is full and ready, like the towered cup standing at the centre of the card. Something emotionally significant is at the heart of the matter: a new feeling, an offer of love, an inspiration asking to be received. Let yourself feel it fully before you try to define it.
ctx.future: A fresh tide of feeling is coming toward you. Expect a new affection, a reconciliation, a creative spark or a moment of grace that fills a place you thought would stay empty. Keep a little room open inside you so there is space to receive it.
ctx.challenge: The cup's walls and towers can become a fortress. The obstacle may be guarding your heart so carefully that nothing gets in or out, or the opposite, pouring out feeling with no ground beneath it. This card asks you to let love be both protected and shared.
ctx.advice: Lift the lid. Say what you feel, offer the gesture of care, sit in prayer or meditation, or make the thing your heart is longing to make. Treat your emotions as sacred rather than inconvenient, and let them lead the next step.
ctx.self: You are carrying a large heart right now, perhaps larger than you realise. You may feel tender, devoted, newly in love with someone or something. Honour that inner richness, because your capacity to feel deeply is one of your truest powers.
ctx.others: Others may see you as warm, generous and emotionally present, a person whose care feels like shelter. Or someone around you is offering a sincere feeling, an invitation or a kindness. Notice who is holding out a full cup to you, and receive it graciously.
ctx.hopes: You hope to love and be loved without holding back, to feel your heart filled to the brim. You may also fear that such openness will leave you exposed. The card reminds you that a heart can be a fortress and a fountain at the same time.
ctx.love: This is one of the loveliest cards for love: a new romance, a deepening commitment or a renewal of feeling between partners. It speaks of sincere emotion and a bond that feels sacred. If you are single, open your heart's doors, because love answers receptivity.
ctx.work: At work, the Ace of Cups brings a project you genuinely care about, a vocation of service, healing or art, or a team that feels like family. Let your heart guide what you pour yourself into. It promises meaning first; practical details still need your attention.
ctx.spirit: Spirit offers you a vessel of grace. Your guides remind you that the divine lives in the heart's sanctuary, not only in distant heavens. Pray, light a candle or simply breathe into your chest: the holy is already housed within you.
ctx.release: Let go of the belief that your heart must stay locked to stay safe. Release old disappointments that have built walls around your feeling. The cup is meant to be filled, emptied and filled again, not kept sealed forever.
ctx.shadow: Beneath the surface may lie an untapped wealth of emotion, a love you have not yet admitted or a longing for the sacred you keep brushing aside. It could also be a habit of idealising feeling so much that ordinary, everyday love never seems enough.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation is a deep emotional need: to love, to belong, to feel that something in life is holy. Everything else grows from that source. Acknowledge it plainly and the rest of the picture will make much more sense.
ctx.gift: Your gift is a heart that can hold a great deal and still give. This capacity for devotion, tenderness and wonder is a hidden help in your situation; it can heal, reconcile and inspire where cleverness alone would fail.

name: Two of Cups
title: Deux de Coupes
imagery: Two golden cups stand side by side, with a blue stem rising between them out of a red blossom that holds it like a ring. At the top the stem opens into a red-and-blue flower from which two blue dolphin-like creatures curl apart with open mouths, and a yellow banner below carries a crowned shield of fleurs-de-lis between green leaves. The twin cups are two hearts meeting, the single stem is the bond that grows from them, and the creatures turning outward hint that even true union keeps two distinct beings.
meaning: The Two of Cups is love in gestation: two hearts recognising each other while something begins to grow between them. In the Marseille numerology two is accumulation and preparation, a pause in which energy gathers before it acts, so this card speaks of attraction, promise and tender courtship more than of a finished story. The stem rising between the cups shows that a relationship is a third living thing, fed by both people yet belonging to neither alone. It can describe a romance, a deep friendship, a reconciliation or a partnership built on mutual feeling. Its counsel is to cherish what is quietly forming and let it ripen in its own time.
numerology: Two is accumulation and gestation in the Marseille tradition: the first meeting of opposites and the patient gathering of energy before action. In Cups it is feeling discovering its mirror.
affirmation: I meet others heart to heart and let something beautiful grow between us.

ctx.past: A meaningful bond lies behind this situation: a meeting, a pact or a mutual attraction that once felt like recognition. Whether or not it endured, that experience of being met heart to heart planted something that is still growing in you.
ctx.present: At the heart of the matter is a relationship in its forming stage. Two people, or two parts of you, are mirroring each other and testing the ground. Give the connection patience, because something real is gestating between the cups.
ctx.future: A meeting of hearts is on its way. It might be a new love, a reconciliation, a partner in work or a friend who truly understands you. Expect mutual feeling and the slow, sweet growth of trust rather than instant fireworks.
ctx.challenge: Two cups can simply stand there admiring each other. The obstacle may be a bond stuck in endless promise, each waiting for the other to move first, or losing yourself in someone else's reflection. Union needs two whole people and a little courage.
ctx.advice: Reach toward the other. Make the call, propose the collaboration, speak the tender thing aloud. Then nourish the bond through small, consistent gestures, the way the single stem is fed by both cups at once.
ctx.self: You are in a receptive, relational mood, looking for someone to share your feelings with, and you may be seeing yourself mostly through your connections. Remember that you are one of the two cups, complete in yourself even as you reach out.
ctx.others: Others see you as a natural partner, someone easy to connect with and trust. Or a person in your circle is drawn to you and quietly hoping for closer ties. The atmosphere around you favours cooperation and mutual respect.
ctx.hopes: You hope for a true counterpart, someone who meets you as an equal. You may also fear that the feeling is not returned, or that closeness will cost you yourself. Both the hope and the fear show how much this bond matters.
ctx.love: A beautiful card for love: attraction, courtship, engagement or renewed tenderness in a couple. It favours reciprocity and honest feeling. Let the relationship grow at its natural pace, tending it like a plant rather than forcing it like a stuck door.
ctx.work: In work, the Two of Cups favours partnerships, agreements and collaborations built on goodwill. A business relationship or creative pairing can bear fruit if both sides contribute fairly. Clarify the terms kindly, so the harmony rests on more than good intentions.
ctx.spirit: Spirit speaks of sacred union, the meeting of the soul with its counterpart, whether a person, the divine or a hidden part of yourself. Your guides remind you that you are never truly alone; something answers whenever your heart calls out.
ctx.release: Release the need to have the relationship fully defined right now, and stop measuring your bond against an ideal. Two is a season of gestation, and what grows between you does not need to be finished to be real.
ctx.shadow: The hidden side may be a longing to merge so completely that you lose your edges, or a fear of intimacy dressed up as patience. The creatures at the top of the card turn away from each other; notice where you quietly pull back.
ctx.foundation: The root of this situation is the human need for connection and recognition. A relationship, or the longing for one, lies underneath everything else. Understand what you are seeking in the other and you will understand the whole matter.
ctx.gift: Your gift is the capacity to form real bonds. Your warmth, your listening and your willingness to meet people halfway are hidden strengths here, and the right alliance can carry you further than you could travel alone.

name: Three of Cups
title: Trois de Coupes
imagery: One golden cup sits high at the top of the card while two stand below, embraced by curving branches that bloom with red petals, blue buds and feathered blue leaves. At the centre a blue fleur-de-lis opens upward around a yellow spear-shaped bud, with a red bud hanging beneath it. The two lower cups seem to give birth to the third above them, and the rising lily and enfolding branches show feeling bursting into flower.
meaning: Three in the Marseille tradition is explosion, the first burst of creative energy after the gestation of two, full of youth and enthusiasm. In Cups this is the heart in springtime: falling in love, a joyful reunion, the birth of a child, a project or a friendship that feels like a celebration. The arrangement of two cups below and one above is a living image of union producing something new that rises from the meeting of two. There can be a little naivety in this exuberance, since the feeling has not yet been tested by time. Enjoy the blossoming wholeheartedly, and let your joy find expression in words, art, laughter and generous gestures.
numerology: Three is explosion and first creation, the youthful leap out of gestation into expression. In Cups it is the heart's first flowering.
affirmation: I let my joy bloom openly and share it freely.

ctx.past: A season of joy and blossoming lies behind you: a celebration, a new love, a creative breakthrough or a happy gathering. That burst of feeling opened you up and left seeds that are still sprouting in your present circumstances.
ctx.present: Your heart is in bloom right now. Something fresh and joyful sits at the centre of things, perhaps a new attraction, a creative idea or good news shared with friends. Let it rise freely, like the single cup at the top of the card.
ctx.future: A happy flowering is coming: an emotional breakthrough, a celebration, a pregnancy of ideas or of life, a reunion with people you love. Expect enthusiasm and fresh energy, and plan to share the good fortune with others.
ctx.challenge: The shadow of three is overexcitement: falling for the feeling before you know the person, scattering your joy in too many directions, or promising more than you can sustain. Keep your enthusiasm, but give it a little root.
ctx.advice: Express what you feel. Write the poem, host the gathering, tell someone you are glad they exist. Creative and emotional energy wants an outlet now, and the very act of sharing it will help it grow strong.
ctx.self: You feel youthful, lively and emotionally expressive, eager to celebrate and to create something of your own. That spontaneity is attractive and healing to be around. Trust your enthusiasm, while noticing which of your new loves deserve the most care.
ctx.others: People see you as joyful, sociable and bubbling with life, someone who warms a room. Or the environment itself is festive and supportive, full of friends and good news. Say yes to the invitations coming your way.
ctx.hopes: You hope for a fresh, happy chapter, for love or creativity to flower again. You may also fear that the joy will fade quickly or that you are being naive. Allow yourself to enjoy the blossom without demanding a guarantee of fruit.
ctx.love: In love, the Three of Cups brings the excitement of a new romance or the renewed playfulness of an established one, and it may hint at a growing family. Keep things light and genuine, and let the bond reveal itself over time.
ctx.work: At work, this is a creative surge: fresh ideas, a successful launch, team spirit and good morale. Celebrate early wins with colleagues. Just remember that a blossom is not yet a harvest, so follow through on what you have begun.
ctx.spirit: Spirit invites you into joy as a form of prayer. Your guides rejoice with you and remind you that delight is sacred too. Singing, dancing and gathering with kindred souls can open your heart to the divine.
ctx.release: Let go of the need to be serious all the time, and release any guilt about enjoying yourself. Release, too, the habit of judging new feelings as foolish before they have had a chance to grow.
ctx.shadow: A hidden tendency to chase the high of new beginnings may be at work, leaving you restless once the first bloom passes. Or there is a joy you have kept hidden for fear others would not share it. Look at where your enthusiasm hides.
ctx.foundation: Beneath this situation lies a creative, joyful impulse, a desire to bring something new to life. A union, real or symbolic, has produced a third thing. Recognise what is being born and you will find the root of the matter.
ctx.gift: Your gift is contagious enthusiasm. Your ability to celebrate, create and make others feel welcome is a hidden help in this situation. Lightness of heart can open doors that seriousness keeps firmly closed, so let your joy lead the way.

name: Four of Cups
title: Quatre de Coupes
imagery: Four golden cups stand in a perfect square, two above and two below, framing a single blue stem that rises through the middle. A red flower blooms at its centre with blue-and-red feathered leaves reaching to either side, a small red cup-shaped blossom and a blue lily crown its top, and a red bud hangs at its base. The square of cups is the heart made secure, while the one flowering stem shows that life keeps growing quietly inside that safe structure.
meaning: Four in the Marseille tradition is stability, the square, the solid table standing firmly on its legs after the explosion of three. In Cups it describes feeling that has found a home: a secure relationship, a loving family, a settled emotional life and the comfort of knowing where you belong. This is not passion but steadiness, the trust that comes from commitment and reliability. The stem flowering between the cups reminds you that security is the soil in which deeper love can grow. Value what is stable in your heart, and use that safety as a base to grow from rather than a place to hide.
numerology: Four is stability and foundation in the Marseille tradition, the square and the four corners of the world. In Cups it is the heart finding safe ground.
affirmation: My heart rests on solid ground, and from there I grow.

ctx.past: Your past held a period of emotional security: a home, a steady relationship or a family structure that kept you safe. That stability formed your expectations of love and still gives you a quiet inner foundation to stand on.
ctx.present: Things are settled in your heart right now. The relationship, the home or the emotional situation feels stable and dependable. The heart of the matter is appreciating this security without letting it harden into mere routine.
ctx.future: Emotional stability is on its way. A relationship may become more committed, a home may be found, or your inner life may finally feel calm and ordered. Expect a time when you can rest and trust what you have built.
ctx.challenge: Four can become a box. The obstacle may be comfort turning into complacency, a fear of change that keeps you in an overly familiar pattern, or emotions held so tidily that nothing new can enter. Security is meant to support life, not replace it.
ctx.advice: Strengthen the foundations. Keep your promises, create small rituals of care, and make your home and relationships reliable places. Then, from that steady base, let the central flower keep growing through little acts of renewal.
ctx.self: You feel steady and emotionally grounded, perhaps more mature and dependable than you were before, and you know clearly what you value. Make sure your need for safety does not quietly limit your openness to new feeling.
ctx.others: Others see you as loyal, calm and reliable, the person everyone can lean on. Or your environment is stable and supportive, a family or community that holds you. Appreciate the structures that are holding you up.
ctx.hopes: You hope for a secure, peaceful emotional life and a place where you truly belong. You may also fear that such stability will turn dull. Both feelings can live together, because steadiness and aliveness are not enemies.
ctx.love: In love, the Four of Cups describes a committed, stable relationship: moving in together, building a home or simply trusting each other deeply. If you are single, it suggests readiness for something lasting. Tend the routine with tenderness.
ctx.work: At work, this card brings stability: a secure position, a loyal team, a dependable base of clients or colleagues. It favours careful consolidation over bold risks. Make your workplace emotionally healthy and good results tend to follow.
ctx.spirit: Spirit invites you to make a sanctuary of daily life. Your guides speak through regular practice, the simple repeated rituals that build a stable altar within you. Faithfulness itself, kept day after day, becomes a quiet and powerful form of prayer.
ctx.release: Let go of the fear that if you change anything at all, everything will collapse. Release habits that preserve comfort at the expense of honesty. A truly stable foundation can bear a little movement, and may even grow stronger for it.
ctx.shadow: Beneath this stability may lie an unspoken fear of insecurity, perhaps from an earlier time when you lacked a safe home or steady love. Notice whether you cling to order to avoid feeling what is underneath it.
ctx.foundation: The root of this situation is a need for emotional security. A home, a family or a commitment underpins everything here, even if it is rarely spoken of. Understanding how much safety matters to you explains many of your choices.
ctx.gift: Your gift is reliability. You can create a safe container for other people's feelings as well as your own, and this steady, faithful presence is a hidden strength that makes healing, trust and lasting love possible.

name: Five of Cups
title: Cinq de Coupes
imagery: Four golden cups stand at the corners while a fifth rises in the centre, held in a heart-shaped garland of blue branches that spring from a red flower at the bottom. Two red roses bloom on either side of the central cup, broad blue-and-red leaves stretch outward above it, and at the top a blue pine-cone bud tipped in red points upward. The square of four is stable ground; the fifth cup in the middle is a new ideal of the heart, cradled by living growth and lifted toward something higher.
meaning: Five in the Marseille numerology is the step beyond the stable square of four, a bridge toward a new ideal that brings both inspiration and tension. In Cups this means the heart discovering something beyond comfort: a new love, a spiritual calling, a deeper faith or a cause that moves you. The central cup, cradled in a heart of branches, shows a new focus of feeling emerging from the middle of a secure life. This can stir restlessness, as old forms stop satisfying, but it is the restlessness of growth. Follow the new interest with sincerity while keeping your feet on the ground the four corner cups provide.
numerology: Five is the bridge in the Marseille tradition, the step beyond the stable four toward a new ideal, carrying both temptation and inspiration. In Cups it is the heart's new calling.
affirmation: I follow the new longing of my heart with courage and care.

ctx.past: At some point you stepped beyond a safe emotional pattern toward something new: a fresh love, a faith, a dream. That leap unsettled what had been stable, but it also widened your heart, and its influence is still felt today.
ctx.present: A new ideal is awakening at the centre of your emotional life. Something or someone has captured your interest, and you feel drawn beyond what you know. The heart of the matter is how to welcome that calling without abandoning your foundations.
ctx.future: A fresh emotional or spiritual interest is coming: a person, a passion, a teacher or a path of meaning that invites you to grow. Expect some restlessness as you cross the bridge between old comfort and new longing.
ctx.challenge: The shadow of five is temptation and idealisation: chasing a dream of love that may not be real, or leaving what is good for what merely glitters. This card asks you to test your new ideal honestly before giving it everything.
ctx.advice: Honour the new longing, but let it grow the way the central cup does, held and supported by what is already stable. Explore, study, meet people who share your new interest, and take one sincere step at a time.
ctx.self: You feel a fresh calling in your heart and perhaps some restlessness with your current life, as if you were outgrowing an old shape. Trust that this longing has something to teach you, even if its final form is not yet clear.
ctx.others: Others may see you as searching or inspired, someone in the middle of a change. A person in your environment may also act as a bridge, a mentor or guide who opens a new emotional or spiritual horizon for you.
ctx.hopes: You hope for something more: a deeper love, a truer faith, a meaningful purpose. You may also fear losing the safety you already have. The card reminds you that both can coexist if you build the bridge with care.
ctx.love: In love, the Five of Cups may describe a new attraction that unsettles a comfortable pattern, or a couple seeking to deepen their bond through a shared ideal. Be honest about what you truly want, and avoid idealising someone you barely know.
ctx.work: At work, a new interest or vocation is calling. You may feel drawn toward work with more meaning, a training or a cause. Explore it with curiosity, but do not burn bridges before the new path has proved itself.
ctx.spirit: Spirit is calling you toward a higher ideal. Your guides are awakening a longing for meaning, a sense that life holds more than security. Answer with study, devotion or contemplation, for this bridge leads somewhere real.
ctx.release: Let go of the belief that you must choose between stability and inspiration, and release the guilt of wanting more. Release, too, any fantasy that keeps you from seeing the actual person or path in front of you.
ctx.shadow: Hidden beneath may be a habit of falling for ideals rather than realities, or a spiritual hunger you have been trying to feed with lesser things. Notice, gently and honestly, what your longing is really pointing toward.
ctx.foundation: At the root lies an awakening of the heart beyond its comfort zone. A new ideal, faith or love has entered your life and is reshaping your priorities. This is the engine quietly driving the whole situation.
ctx.gift: Your gift is the courage to grow emotionally and spiritually; you will not settle for less than meaning. That willingness to cross the bridge toward a higher ideal is a hidden strength in your situation.

name: Six of Cups
title: Six de Coupes
imagery: Six golden cups stand in two columns of three, facing each other like partners in a dance. Between them a single stem climbs from a yellow bud at the base through blue and red blossoms, with a red four-petalled flower opening at the very centre and a blue bow-shaped flower near the top. The mirrored columns are hearts in balanced exchange, and the central flower is the delight that blooms when you find what you truly love.
meaning: Six in the Marseille numerology is pleasure and beauty, the moment after the bridge of five when you discover what you love and unite with it. In Cups this is one of the sweetest cards: emotional harmony, mutual affection, the joy of being with kindred spirits and doing what makes your heart sing. The two columns of cups mirror each other exactly, as in a loving relationship where giving and receiving are in balance. The flower at the centre shows that this pleasure is alive and nourishing, not superficial. The card invites you to choose with your heart, follow beauty and let yourself enjoy the good that is offered.
numerology: Six is pleasure and beauty in the Marseille tradition, the joy of finding and uniting with what one loves. In Cups it is emotional delight held in balance.
affirmation: I choose what I love, and I let myself enjoy it.

ctx.past: Your past contains a time of real emotional pleasure: a happy relationship, a childhood joy or a period of harmony with others. That memory of delight is a resource, reminding you what it feels like when your heart is truly fed.
ctx.present: You are in a season of emotional harmony right now, or very close to one. The heart of the matter is pleasure, beauty and connection with what you love. Allow yourself to enjoy what is good without waiting for permission.
ctx.future: Delight is coming: a loving encounter, a harmonious period in your relationships, or the discovery of something that fills you with joy. Expect a balance of giving and receiving that makes life feel sweet again.
ctx.challenge: The challenge of six is using pleasure as an escape, or clinging so tightly to sweetness that you avoid needed honesty. It can also be the struggle to know what you truly love. This card asks you to choose your delight consciously.
ctx.advice: Follow the pleasure that nourishes you. Spend time with people who gladden your heart, give yourself to beautiful things, and choose the path you love rather than the one you think you ought to take.
ctx.self: You are in touch with what you love and learning to say yes to it. You may feel lighter, more affectionate and more open than before. Trust that your joy is a valid guide to your next choices.
ctx.others: Others see you as kind, charming and easy to be around. Or your environment is warm and harmonious, full of people with whom you share genuine affection. Let yourself be held and enjoyed by that circle.
ctx.hopes: You hope for harmony, affection and a life full of beauty, and you may fear that such happiness is fleeting or undeserved. The card reassures you that pleasure belongs to a well-lived life rather than distracting from it.
ctx.love: In love, the Six of Cups is a joyful, harmonious bond: mutual tenderness, playfulness, shared tastes and a sense of rightness. It favours choosing the person who truly delights you. Express affection openly and keep the exchange balanced.
ctx.work: At work, this card favours doing what you love. Creative, artistic or caring work goes well, and harmonious collaboration makes tasks lighter. If your current job feels joyless, consider what could bring some beauty back into it.
ctx.spirit: Spirit speaks to you through beauty. Your guides invite you to find the sacred in art, nature, music and love, in the simple things that make you catch your breath. Pleasure that is sincere and shared becomes a doorway to the divine.
ctx.release: Let go of the belief that you must suffer to deserve good things. Release obligations that leave no room for joy, along with any lingering guilt about loving what you love, because delight is not a debt you will have to repay.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be a reluctance to admit what really gives you pleasure, or an old habit of pleasing others at the expense of your own heart. Look honestly, and kindly, at what you truly desire.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation lies a search for emotional fulfilment and beauty. The longing for harmony and delight is what drives events. Knowing clearly what you love is the key to everything else.
ctx.gift: Your gift is the capacity to enjoy and to create harmony. Your sense of beauty, your affection and your knack for balanced exchange are hidden strengths that make the path sweeter for everyone around you.

name: Seven of Cups
title: Sept de Coupes
imagery: Three golden cups stand in a row at the top and three at the bottom, while a seventh rests alone in the centre, encircled by curling blue and red leaves that rise from a small blue bud below. The leaves sweep outward like waves or flames, as if energy were flowing from the middle cup to all the others. The central cup is the heart in action, radiating feeling outward and linking the row above with the row below.
meaning: Seven in the Marseille tradition is action in the world, the most dynamic of the numbers, energy that goes out and makes things happen. In Cups this is love that does not stay at home: generosity, kindness in action, emotional energy poured into people, causes and creative work. The central cup ringed by swirling leaves is like a heart radiating outward, nourishing the rows of cups around it. The card speaks of acting on your feelings, giving wholeheartedly and letting your love leave a mark on the world. Make sure your own cup is refilled as well as emptied, and your generosity will stay joyful.
numerology: Seven is action in the world in the Marseille tradition, energy moving outward to transform its surroundings. In Cups it is love made active and generous.
affirmation: My love moves outward and makes a difference.

ctx.past: In the past you poured a great deal of heart into the world: caring for others, serving a cause, giving generously in love or friendship. That active love left its mark on people and helped shape the situation you are in now.
ctx.present: Your heart is in motion right now. You are giving, acting and expressing feelings in ways that touch other people. The heart of the matter is how your love moves through the world and what it is creating there.
ctx.future: A time of active, outward love is approaching. Expect chances to help, to share and to turn your feelings into concrete action. Your generosity will reach further than you expect and will return to you in new forms.
ctx.challenge: The shadow of seven in Cups is giving until you are empty, or scattering your feelings in too many directions at once. It can also mean acting on emotion too quickly. Direct your love wisely and keep your own cup filled.
ctx.advice: Act on what you feel. Do the kind deed, make the generous offer, bring your care where it is needed. Let your heart be practical, and choose a few channels where your love can truly do good.
ctx.self: You see yourself as someone who gives and acts from the heart, and your warmth is active rather than passive. Ask yourself honestly whether you are also allowing love, help and appreciation to flow back toward you.
ctx.others: Others see you as generous, warm and engaged, a person whose care makes things happen. Or someone in your environment is pouring their love into a project or into you. Notice that energy and honour it.
ctx.hopes: You hope your love and effort will make a real difference. You may fear that your giving is never enough, or that it will drain you. Trust the circular flow on this card: what radiates from the centre comes back.
ctx.love: In love, the Seven of Cups brings affection expressed through action: thoughtful gestures, shared projects, care woven into daily life. A relationship grows through what you do for each other. Balance giving with receiving so neither partner runs dry.
ctx.work: At work, this card favours vocations of service, care, art or community, and emotional intelligence is your engine now. Pour your heart into what you do, but set healthy limits so your generosity remains sustainable.
ctx.spirit: Spirit asks you to make love visible. Your guides remind you that compassion in action is a form of prayer, as holy as any words spoken at an altar. Serve, help and bless, and you will feel something greater moving through your hands.
ctx.release: Release the need to keep your feelings private, or to wait for perfect conditions before acting on them. Let go of martyrdom as well, because love is meant to circulate and renew you, not to empty you out.
ctx.shadow: A hidden pattern of giving in order to be needed may lie beneath the surface, or a habit of keeping busy for others so you never have to sit with your own feelings. Look gently at the motives behind your generosity.
ctx.foundation: At the root is a heart that wants to act and make a difference. Emotional energy is looking for an outlet in the world. Understand where it longs to flow and the situation will start to make sense.
ctx.gift: Your gift is active love: you do not merely feel, you act on what you feel. That warmth in motion is a hidden help in your situation and a blessing to the people it reaches.

name: Eight of Cups
title: Huit de Coupes
imagery: Eight golden cups are arranged three above, two in the middle and three below, with a blue rosette blooming between the middle pair like a star. Small flame-shaped buds of yellow and red rise above and below the rosette, while red tulips and feathered blue leaves curve out in matching garlands on either side. The perfectly balanced arrangement and the radiant central flower suggest a heart filled to completeness, every vessel in its proper place.
meaning: Eight in the Marseille numerology is perfection and plenitude, the full and balanced state in which nothing needs to be added or taken away. In Cups this is emotional fulfilment: a heart that is full, a love that feels complete, an inner life rich enough to rest in itself. The blue rosette glowing among the cups is like a quiet star, a sign of deep peace and receptivity. This card invites gratitude for what fills you and the awareness that true abundance is felt from the inside. Such fullness is best enjoyed in stillness rather than by grasping for more, letting the heart simply be satisfied.
numerology: Eight is perfection and plenitude in the Marseille tradition, the balance of the full measure. In Cups it is a heart filled to completeness.
affirmation: My heart is full, and I receive its abundance with gratitude.

ctx.past: Behind you lies a time of emotional fullness, when love, family or inner peace felt complete. That experience of having enough taught you what contentment is, and it remains a deep well you can draw from now.
ctx.present: Your heart is full right now, or capable of being full if you let yourself notice. The heart of the matter is recognising the abundance of love and meaning already present, rather than searching elsewhere for what is here.
ctx.future: A period of emotional plenitude is coming, when relationships, inner life and feeling come into balance. Expect a sense of completeness and quiet joy, the peace of a heart that no longer needs to chase anything.
ctx.challenge: The challenge of eight is a perfection so complete it leaves no room to move: emotional self-sufficiency that becomes closed, or a demand that every feeling be ideal. This card asks you to let fullness breathe and stay open to life.
ctx.advice: Pause and take stock of everything that fills your heart right now. Practise gratitude, rest in what is good, and let yourself receive instead of always striving for the next thing. Abundance deepens when you stop long enough to feel it.
ctx.self: You feel emotionally rich and settled, perhaps more whole in yourself than ever before. Your inner life has become a source of strength. Let that fullness show, so that others can benefit from the peace you carry.
ctx.others: Others see you as serene, warm and complete in yourself, someone whose presence feels nourishing. Or you are surrounded by a full and loving circle that offers you everything you need. Let it hold you.
ctx.hopes: You hope to feel truly full, loved and at peace. You may also fear that such completeness cannot last, or that you are not allowed to have it. The card says this plenitude is real and yours to receive.
ctx.love: In love, the Eight of Cups describes a deeply fulfilling relationship in which both people feel complete and cherished. It favours mature, receptive love. If you are single, it suggests your own heart is full enough to welcome a partner without neediness.
ctx.work: At work, this card brings satisfaction and the sense that your efforts have reached their full measure. The emotional rewards are strong: appreciation, belonging and meaning. Enjoy this plateau fully before you rush to set new goals.
ctx.spirit: Spirit fills your cup to the brim. Your guides invite you into receptive prayer, the stillness in which grace pours in without effort. You are held in an abundance far larger than you can measure.
ctx.release: Let go of the restless feeling that something is always missing. Release the habit of comparing the fullness of your heart with that of others. What you have right now is already more than enough to rest in.
ctx.shadow: Hidden beneath may be an attachment to emotional perfection, a fear of disturbing a beautiful balance by saying something honest. Such fullness can also hide a quiet loneliness that no one is ever allowed to see.
ctx.foundation: At the root of this situation is a deep inner richness, a store of love and feeling that has been carefully gathered over time. That reservoir sustains everything else here, so draw from it consciously.
ctx.gift: Your gift is inner abundance. You can feel complete, receive fully and radiate a peace that others notice the moment you enter a room. This capacity to be filled and grateful is a hidden source of healing in your situation.

name: Nine of Cups
title: Neuf de Coupes
imagery: Nine golden cups stand in three orderly rows of three, like a well-stocked cellar or a choir of voices. Between the rows two great sprays of blue and red leaves spread out sideways like wings, while long feathered leaves rise and fall between the cups. There is no flower at the centre now; the plant has become pure foliage, as if the bloom had done its work and the heart had matured into a calm, abundant wisdom.
meaning: Nine in the Marseille tradition marks a turning point, the end of a cycle and a crisis of maturity that prepares the birth of something new. In Cups it brings emotional wisdom and deep satisfaction, the contentment of someone who has felt a great deal and learned from it. The rows of cups are full and evenly spaced, but the flowers have given way to spreading leaves, a sign that passion is ripening into a calmer, more seasoned feeling. Wishes can come true here, and the card also asks you to let old attachments complete themselves gracefully. What has ripened can be gathered with joy, and what is finished can be released with thanks.
numerology: Nine is the turning point of the Marseille cycle, the crisis of completion and the wisdom that lets go so that something new can be born. In Cups it is emotional maturity.
affirmation: I gather what has ripened in my heart and welcome what comes next.

ctx.past: In the past you reached a point of emotional maturity, perhaps after a long relationship or a meaningful chapter came to its natural close. That experience gave you wisdom about the heart, and it still steadies you now.
ctx.present: You are at an emotional turning point. Much has ripened, and you can feel genuinely satisfied with what you have lived. The heart of the matter is enjoying this fulfilment while sensing that a new cycle is quietly preparing itself.
ctx.future: A deep satisfaction is coming, the feeling that a wish has been granted or a chapter has been rounded off well. Expect contentment and a calm sense of readiness for whatever new beginning lies beyond it.
ctx.challenge: The shadow of nine is clinging to a cycle that has already completed, or resting so comfortably in contentment that you ignore the call to change. This card asks you to let ripe things fall from the branch in their own time.
ctx.advice: Count your blessings and name, one by one, what you have learned along the way. Celebrate what has worked, close any emotional loose ends, and allow yourself a season of reflection before rushing into the next adventure.
ctx.self: You feel wiser and more contented than you once did, comfortable in your own emotional skin. You know what makes you happy. Trust that inner authority, while staying curious about who you are still becoming.
ctx.others: Others see you as satisfied, mature and emotionally seasoned, someone whose calm reassures them in uncertain times. Or the people around you are pleased and supportive, ready to celebrate the good that has come to you.
ctx.hopes: You hope your heart's wishes will come true and that life will feel deeply satisfying. You may fear that once you are content, change will take it away. The card reminds you that endings in nine are ripening, not loss.
ctx.love: In love, the Nine of Cups speaks of a mature, satisfying bond and wishes fulfilled. A relationship may be moving to a new stage after a long, rich chapter. If you are single, you may be ready to love from contentment rather than need.
ctx.work: At work, this card brings satisfaction with what you have achieved and recognition for your efforts. It can also signal that a phase is completing. Enjoy the success, and listen for the next calling forming beneath it.
ctx.spirit: Spirit speaks of wisdom gained through feeling. Your guides honour everything your heart has lived, the joys and the sorrows alike, and invite you into a quiet, contemplative space. Gratitude and reflection open the door to your next spiritual season.
ctx.release: Release emotional attachments that have completed their purpose, and let go of old wishes you no longer truly want. Thank them sincerely for what they gave you, then make generous room in your heart for the new.
ctx.shadow: Hidden beneath your contentment may be a reluctance to grow further, or a fear that any change will spoil what you have. Notice where satisfaction has become a reason to stop listening to your heart.
ctx.foundation: The root of this situation is emotional maturity and a cycle reaching its fullness. Much has been lived and learned here, and that hard-won wisdom forms the foundation for the choices you are making now.
ctx.gift: Your gift is seasoned wisdom of the heart. You know how to feel deeply without drowning, and how to let go with gratitude. That maturity is a hidden help to you and to everyone who leans on you.

name: Ten of Cups
title: Dix de Coupes
imagery: Nine upright golden cups stand in three neat rows beneath a tenth, larger cup laid on its side across the top of the card, its open mouth turned to the left as if ready to pour. There are no flowers or leaves at all, only the vessels themselves. The full rows show emotional completion, and the tilted cup shows a heart filled to the brim that must now overflow and give what it holds to a new cycle.
meaning: Ten in the Marseille numerology completes the cycle and turns toward the next, like a wheel finishing one turn and beginning another. In Cups it is emotional completion: love fulfilled, a family or community made whole, a heart so full that it begins to pour itself outward. The striking detail is the great cup lying on its side above the others; it is no longer a container but a fountain, emptying its contents so that the flow can continue. The card speaks of happiness that is shared and of feelings brought to their natural fulfilment so that a new chapter can begin. Celebrate what is complete, and let your full heart overflow generously into what comes next.
numerology: Ten is the end of the cycle and the threshold of the next in the Marseille tradition, completion that already turns toward renewal. In Cups it is the full heart beginning to pour.
affirmation: My heart is full, and I let its abundance flow onward.

ctx.past: Behind you lies a chapter of emotional completeness: a happy home, a fulfilled love or a community where you truly belonged. That cycle has run its course, and its blessings are now pouring forward into your present life.
ctx.present: Your heart has reached a point of completion. A relationship, a family situation or an emotional journey is fulfilled, and the cup is tipping to pour. The heart of the matter is sharing this fullness and preparing for a new chapter.
ctx.future: Emotional fulfilment is coming, along with the overflow that follows it. Expect happiness shared with loved ones, a family milestone or a love that feels whole, and then a gentle opening toward a new cycle of life.
ctx.challenge: The challenge of ten is resisting the pour: trying to keep a completed chapter frozen in place, or fearing that once the cup is emptied nothing will refill it. This card asks you to trust the flow beyond fulfilment.
ctx.advice: Share your happiness. Give back to the people and places that filled your heart, celebrate milestones together, and allow one chapter to close gracefully so that the next can begin with an open, willing cup.
ctx.self: You feel emotionally complete, perhaps surprised by how much love your life holds. You are ready to give from that fullness. Let yourself be a source for others rather than only a vessel that receives.
ctx.others: Others see you as blessed and generous, a heart that overflows into the lives around you. Or your family, friends or community are enjoying a happy, complete time together. You are part of something whole.
ctx.hopes: You hope for lasting emotional fulfilment, a loving family or a circle where you fully belong. You may fear that happiness at its peak must fade. The card answers that a full cup does not end; it pours forward.
ctx.love: In love, the Ten of Cups brings fulfilment: a relationship that feels whole, a family growing or a commitment reaching its natural next step. Shared happiness is emphasised. Let your love flow outward into friends, family and community too.
ctx.work: At work, this card points to the successful completion of an emotionally meaningful project, and to teams that feel like family. As one cycle ends, its rewards flow onward into the next. Pass on what you have learned.
ctx.spirit: Spirit shows you a cup tipped to pour. Your guides remind you that grace is meant to flow onward, not be stored away. Blessings shared become larger, and you are invited to be a channel for that abundance.
ctx.release: Let go of the need to hold onto a completed chapter exactly as it was. Release fear of emptiness; the poured cup makes room for new feeling. Trust that love moves in cycles, not straight lines.
ctx.shadow: Hidden beneath this happiness may be an anxiety about what comes after fulfilment, or a sense of having nowhere left to grow. Notice where you might be gripping the cup tightly instead of letting it pour.
ctx.foundation: At the root of the situation lies a cycle of feeling that has reached its completion. Love has been fully lived here. Everything now flows from that fullness and from the readiness to begin again.
ctx.gift: Your gift is overflowing love. Your heart is full enough to nourish others without being diminished, like the great cup tipped to pour above the rest. That generous fullness is a hidden blessing for everyone your life touches.

name: Valet of Cups
title: Valet de Coupes
imagery: A young man with curly hair wreathed in a garland walks over yellow ground beside a small green plant, dressed in a red tunic, blue sleeves and blue hose, with red shoes and a yellow sash across his shoulder. He lifts an open cup in his right hand while his left holds its round lid low at his side, and his head tilts thoughtfully as his eyes glance away to one side. The uncovered cup is a heart just opening, and the lid held apart and the uncertain tilt of his head speak of shyness, as if he has not yet decided what to do with what he has found.
meaning: The Valet of Cups is the heart as a young apprentice, discovering love, beauty and its own sensitivity for the first time. In the Marseille deck the Valets stand at a threshold, hesitating between holding back and stepping forward, and this one has just lifted the lid from his cup without quite deciding what to offer or to whom. He brings timid feelings, a tender message, a romantic or creative beginning and an invitation to explore your emotional life with curiosity. His garland marks him as a lover and a dreamer, gentle rather than bold. Encourage him in yourself: your feelings are allowed to be new, clumsy and sincere.
